name: WinMain
type: int __stdcall (uint instance, uint previous, char *command_line, int show)
comment: The game's entry, from _WinMainCRTStartup. A second copy finds the first by its StarlancerRunning mutex and restores the first's window instead

name: mission_run
comment: Runs a mission: resets the clocks, then loops, running a game tick for each timer tick since the last pass

name: tick_timer
comment: Timer callback, 100 times a second: advances game_ticks and the play time, unless paused

name: hud_init
comment: Sets the HUD up once, on the first frame that draws it: copies the element names into the table at 0x57BC5C, a hundred bytes each, allocates hud.cpp's work buffer, takes oldpalette.tga and powerball.tga, and works out the 62 by 62 table of shading the power ball, the power distribution display, is drawn from

name: hud_blit
type: void __fastcall (void *pane, void *shapes, int shape, int x, int y, void *buffer, int mirrored)
comment: Draws one of the display's shapes shaken, in place of VFX_shape_draw while hud_interference is above 0: under the hardware renderers each row is shifted sideways by a random amount scaled by hud_interference, or by 0x00588724 for some shapes. Unverified: the last two arguments

name: hud_draw
comment: Draws the head-up display, once a frame. mission_run puts it in sr + 0x88 and Surrender calls it while it renders, so nothing calls it outright and Ghidra does not find it without being told

name: hud_grid_place
comment: Where the item of index stands in the display's grid: from half-way across the screen, 0x30 apart across and 0x26 down, two to a row

name: hud_place
type: void __fastcall (int x, int y, float across, float down, int *out_x, int *out_y)
comment: Where a display element stands, so that it keeps its place at any resolution: the screen's size less 0x21, times the fraction across or down, plus 0x10 and the offset given

name: hud_text
type: void __fastcall (void *pane, int x, int y, void **font, char *text, uint colour, int align)
comment: Draws a line of the display's text with VFX_string_draw, which sprites.cpp looks up out of vfx.dll into 0x00594858: left where align is 0, centred where it is 1 and right where it is 2, the line's width from font_text_width. An empty string draws nothing. Leaves the line's bounding box where the caller asked

name: font_text_width
comment: How wide a string is in a font: the sum of its glyphs' widths, two bytes each from the font's +4

name: game_tick
comment: One tick: the simulation step, unless paused

name: simulation_step
comment: Every fourth tick: each object's own updates, then objects_update and the rest

name: objects_update
comment: Moves every object, then finds colliding pairs by sorting their extents along X

name: objects_collide
comment: Handles two objects whose spheres may meet, pushing them apart when they overlap

name: game_ticks
comment: Ticks since the mission started

name: play_time_ticks
comment: Play time: ticks, rolled into seconds after 101

name: paused
comment: Nonzero while the game is paused, which stops the ticks and the script clock

name: frame_time_sum
comment: Converts the frame's seven timed sections from counter ticks to seconds and totals them in frame_time

name: frame_time
comment: The last frame's timed sections together, in seconds; mission_frame moves detail_divisor by it

name: game_object_count
comment: Slots of game_objects in use, which create_object extends when given no slot

name: camera_set_view
type: int __fastcall (int view, int object, char lock, char force)
comment: Switches the camera to a view of an object: refused while locked unless forced; starts or clears the bars, resets the chase and orbit state, then places the camera

name: camera_frame
comment: Places the camera once a frame for the view: moves the bars, then the cockpit, chase, orbit, flyby and cutaway views

name: camera_chase
comment: The chase view: behind and above the object by ship type, farther with throttle, swinging against its rates of turn

name: camera_chase_level
comment: Zeroes the chase view's swing

name: frame_controls
comment: The controls read once a frame, from mission_frame: the joystick's hat, which glances ahead, left, right or back while held, the camera keys, steering the orbiting views with the arrow keys, and the wingman and other frame keys

name: camera_view_table
comment: For each view: the language string that names it (a halfword), whether the bars slide in, and whether it is from the cockpit. It ends where the text of camera_set_view's assertion on an invalid camera type begins

name: camera_view_last
comment: Last frame's camera_view: mission_frame resets the star streaks when they differ

name: camera_object
comment: The object the view shows

name: cockpit_mode
comment: What the cockpit view shows: 0 no cockpit, 1 the cockpit's model, 2 the chase view; the cockpit key cycles it

name: cockpit_mode_setting
comment: The options' cockpit setting: 0 the cockpit's model, 1 the chase view, 2 no cockpit

name: camera_locked
comment: Set while a script holds the camera; the camera keys do nothing

name: camera_bars
comment: How much of the screen each cinematic bar covers, up to 0.1

name: camera_switched
comment: frame_start when the view last changed

name: chase_distance
comment: Along the object's forward axis, smoothed; 1500 on switching to the chase view

name: orbit_yaw
comment: Degrees

name: orbit_pitch
comment: Degrees, -89.5 to 89.5

name: orbit_yaw_speed
comment: Degrees a tick, up to 5

name: orbit_pitch_speed
comment: Degrees a tick, up to 5

name: orbit_distance
comment: Kept between 1.8 and 3.8 radii of the player's ship, or 5.8 of the target's

name: hit_shake
comment: How much the cockpit view shakes from a hit, falling by 0.02 a tick

name: sr_set_projection
type: void __cdecl (float left, float top, float right, float bottom, float across, float down)
comment: The projection: scales of the screen's size less 0.1 times the factors, the middle, and the viewport's edges in view units and pixels

name: object_bounds
comment: Widens the object's bounds and radius over a node's mesh, and adds its part's inertia to the tensor: the second moments about the two other axes on the diagonal and the products off it, each with the term the part's distance from the object's origin adds, times its density; then the node's children

name: joystick
comment: The joystick as read_joystick last polled it

name: mouse
comment: The mouse as read_mouse last read it: its movement since the read before

name: keyboard
comment: DirectInput's keyboard state, by scan code (DIK_*): nonzero while the key is down

name: key_latched
comment: Set for a key once key_pressed has counted it once, until read_keyboard sees it released

name: button_latched
comment: Set for a joystick button once control_active has counted it once, until read_joystick sees it released

name: shift_latched
comment: Set once key_pressed has counted a Shift combination once, until both Shift keys are up

name: control_latched
comment: Set once key_pressed has counted a Ctrl combination once, until both Ctrl keys are up

name: alt_latched
comment: Set once key_pressed has counted an Alt combination once, until both Alt keys are up

name: control_bindings
comment: Each action's key, modifier, name and joystick button

name: control_mode
comment: What player_controls steers with: the Controller setting

name: joystick_invert
comment: The JoystickInvert setting, 1 by default: while it is clear, player_controls reverses pitch from the stick, keys and mouse

name: twist_enabled
comment: The TwistEnable setting: the joystick's twist (Rz) rolls the ship when it has one

name: force_feedback
comment: Set while the joystick in use has force feedback

name: hat_enabled
comment: The HatEnable setting, 1 by default: while it is set, frame_controls glances with the joystick's first hat

name: hat_glancing
comment: Set while the joystick's hat glances, so that frame_controls looks ahead again once it is let go

name: twist_setting
comment: The TwistEnable setting as load_key_config reads it; twist_enabled is whether it is nonzero

name: force_feedback_setting
comment: The ForceFeedback setting, 1 by default: while it is clear no force-feedback effect starts, and the frame's hits push nothing

name: settings_path
comment: The path of starlancer.ini: the game's directory, then the file's name

name: joystick_caps
comment: The joystick's DIDEVCAPS, which joystick_found takes the button and hat counts from

name: direct_input
comment: The IDirectInput7 interface

name: keyboard_device
comment: The keyboard's IDirectInputDevice7

name: mouse_device
comment: The mouse's IDirectInputDevice7

name: joystick_device
comment: The joystick's IDirectInputDevice7, or null without one

name: force_effects
comment: Each .frc file's effects as force_effects_read made them, in load_force_effects' order: the gun types' from lc to nc, then Missile and Shake; each place that plays one starts its first

name: force_slots
comment: The pushes force_hit_pushes plays, a slot each in turn from force_slot_next, freed as its slot comes round again

name: force_slot_next
comment: The force_slots slot the next effect takes; back to 0 past 8

name: force_files_read
comment: How many .frc files load_force_effects read

name: force_hits
comment: The frame's hits on the player's ship for force_hit_pushes, each its push and its quadrant, up to the first of no push; damage_feedback writes them from force_hit_next

name: force_hit_next
comment: The force_hits entry damage_feedback writes next; back to 0 past 19, and to 0 after force_hit_pushes

name: force_knocks
comment: A second list force_hit_pushes sums as force_hits, which nothing fills

name: joystick_name
comment: The joystick's product name

name: joystick_axes
comment: The joystick's axes the game set up: X, Y and Rz run from -1000 to 1000, Z and the first slider from 0 to 1000

name: joystick_buttons
comment: The joystick's button count

name: joystick_hats
comment: The joystick's point-of-view hat count

name: throttle_setting
comment: The throttle the keys set; the ship's throttle follows it while the afterburner is off

name: matching_speed
comment: Flipped by MATCH SPEED; while set, match_target_speed runs each update. ZERO THROTTLE and FULL THROTTLE clear it

name: throttle_before_match
comment: The throttle match_target_speed puts back when the target leaves range

name: afterburner_toggled
comment: Flipped by AFTERBURNER TOGGLE; the afterburner burns while it is set

name: mouse_missile_latched
comment: Set once the right button has launched a missile in the mouse's mode, until it is let go

name: mouse_range
comment: How far from the centre the mouse's stick reaches, in counts: 800

name: mouse_dead_band
comment: The share of the mouse's stick about the centre that steers nothing: 0.3

name: fuel_warning_tick
comment: The game_ticks value before which the afterburner fuel warning does not sound again

name: load_key_config
comment: Reads the KeyConfig and JoyConfig sections of starlancer.ini: the input settings and each action's binding

name: input_init
comment: Creates DirectInput and the keyboard, mouse and joystick devices, preferring a force-feedback joystick

name: joystick_found
comment: DirectInput's callback for each joystick it enumerates

name: joystick_object_found
comment: DirectInput's callback for each axis, button and hat of the joystick

name: input_acquire
comment: Acquires the keyboard, mouse and joystick, or unacquires them while the word at 0x5DDD28 is set

name: input_shutdown
comment: Unacquires and releases the devices and DirectInput

name: read_keyboard
comment: Reads the keyboard, then clears the latches of released keys and modifiers

name: read_joystick
comment: Polls the joystick into state, then clears the latches of released buttons

name: read_mouse
comment: Reads the mouse's movement since the previous read, and its buttons

name: key_pressed
type: int __fastcall (int key, int modifier, int once)
comment: Whether a key is down with a modifier (ControlModifier); with once, only once for each press

name: load_force_effects
comment: Reads forces\lc.frc to Shake.frc, a gun type's each from the Laser Cannon's to the Nova Cannon's then Missile and Shake, into force_effects by force_effects_read, counting those read; then downloads the missile's

name: force_effects_read
comment: The SideWinder Force Feedback SDK's SWFF_CreateDIEffectFromFileEx: has CLSID_VFX, the Visual Force Effects server, make the DirectInput effects of an .frc file, into an array it allocates

name: force_slot_free
comment: Stops, unloads and forgets the effect in force_slots at slot, if any

name: force_periodic_create
type: long __fastcall (void *device, void **effect, int type, int duration, int period, int direction, int magnitude, int offset, int attack_time, int attack_level, int fade_time, int fade_level, int button)
comment: The SideWinder Force Feedback SDK's SWFF_CreatePeriodicEffect: a periodic effect of type 1 (sine) to 4, times in microseconds and the direction in hundredths of a degree

name: force_shake
comment: Starts the Shake effect unless it is playing, while force_feedback_setting is set; camera_frame runs it while hit_shake is above 0.1, and damage_feedback for a shot

name: force_hit_pushes
comment: Each frame from mission_frame, while force_feedback_setting is set: sums force_hits by the side struck and plays a push across (left less right) and along (fore less aft), a 1-second 2 Hz sine through force_periodic_create in the next of force_slots, for a net stronger than 1; aims the push from the left at 90000, which DirectInput turns down

name: control_active
comment: Whether an action's joystick button, or its key with its modifier, is down; with once, only once for each press

name: player_controls
comment: The Player Control order's update: steering, throttle, weapons and the other flight actions from the controls

name: match_target_speed
comment: Sets the throttle to the target's speed over the player's cruise speed while the target is within 330000 units; otherwise puts the throttle back and stops matching

name: player_throttle_keys
comment: Steps the throttle while ACCELERATE or DECELERATE is held; ZERO THROTTLE and FULL THROTTLE set it

name: order_groups
comment: The order table: for each hundred order numbers, the records of those orders

name: player_slots
comment: Object slots that belong to players, from slot 0: 1 in a single-player game, the player count or 8 in multiplayer

name: mission_frame
comment: mission_run's work for each frame while the game is not paused: among it orders_update, events_flush and mission_ships_sync

name: orders_update
comment: Once a frame: zeroes every object's recent_damage each 500 ticks, then runs object_orders for each object not disabled

name: object_orders
comment: Runs an object's current order: starts its queued orders that are due, clears its burn flags, then runs the order's init if it has yet to start, and its update

name: order_push
type: bool __fastcall (int slot, int order, int kind, int target, int component)
comment: Pushes an order aimed at a target on an object's stack; false when the ship refuses it, the current order does not give way or the stack is full

name: order_push_ship
type: bool __fastcall (int slot, int order, int target, int component)
comment: order_push aimed at a ship, target being its slot

name: order_pop
comment: Pops the current order, running its exit if it has started; false without orders. Unless it was one-shot, the order below starts again

name: order_give_way
comment: Whether the current order gives way to order, or to clearing them all for -1, running its exit if it does; a fatal error where its priority forbids

name: order_refused
comment: Whether the ship in slot refuses order: a player's ship refuses orders below 100 without the players flag

name: orders_clear
comment: Drops every order if the current one gives way, running only its exit

name: orders_pop_all
comment: Pops every order, running each exit

name: order_retaliate
comment: Pushes Fight at the last attacker, of the other side, once the ship's recent_damage reaches 4.2 times its armor class; only between ships whose combat stats hold 1 at +0x28

name: ai_first_setup
comment: Once, while 0x005185B0 is clear: calls 0x00418A70 and puts the action sphere around slot 0 with a radius of 220000

name: order_queue
type: void __fastcall (int slot, OrderEntry *entry, int delay, int value)
comment: Queues an order from another player, due delay ticks after frame_start; an equal order already queued stays if it is due no sooner, and is replaced otherwise

name: avoidance_scan
comment: In mission_frame's pass that draws the objects, for an object whose order has the avoidance flag and no no_avoidance: lists the objects it could hit, those with components whose spheres, 10000 wider, overlap its own at +0x6B8, and the others ai_collision_course puts it on course to hit within 50 steps by 2000 at +0x6E4, ten of each at most

name: object_destroyed
type: void __fastcall (int slot, bool may_spin, bool no_eject)
comment: A ship's end: an AI ship's pilot ejects where +0x74C is clear and eject_roll is under 40, or where told to eject before exploding, leaving the ship to Eject Spin; the player's ejects unless no_eject or already ejected or flying the Kamov; otherwise the ship explodes, its stack overwritten; may_spin goes into the order's data

name: object_destroyed_net
type: void __fastcall (int slot, bool may_spin, bool no_eject)
comment: object_destroyed, first telling the other players (0x004B9C70) where a network session runs a mission that is not multiplayer's; objects_collide's for a torpedo and a mine going off

name: explode_modes
comment: Explode's routines for each mode, 0x18 bytes each: init and update, for a ship, a ship with components as a whole, one of its components, an asteroid and the limpet car

name: explode_ship_init
comment: Explode's init for a ship: heard at once close to the camera, it takes a style (the torpedoes always 2, else object_random15 % 3), the player's has the camera watch it from view 8, 0x1A or 0x1B and sets mission_ending to 1, then the style's init

name: explode_ship
comment: Explode's update for a ship: its style's update until the tick at +4; then explode_burst for style 1, explode_blast for the rest but the torpedoes, and object_retire

name: explode_hull_init
comment: Explode's init for a ship that lists components, going as a whole

name: explode_hull
comment: Explode's update for a ship that lists components, going as a whole

name: explode_component_init
comment: Explode's init for the component of a ship the order is aimed at

name: explode_component
comment: Explode's update for the component of a ship the order is aimed at

name: explode_asteroid_init
comment: Explode's init for an asteroid, types 0x79 to 0x7F

name: explode_asteroid
comment: Explode's update for an asteroid

name: explode_limpet_car_init
comment: Explode's init for the limpet car, type 0x1D

name: explode_limpet_car
comment: Explode's update for the limpet car

name: explode_style_inits
comment: Explode's init for each style a ship goes in: spin out, burst, halt

name: explode_style_updates
comment: Explode's update for each style: explode_spin, noop, explode_spin

name: explode_spin_out_init
comment: Style 0: 50 puffs to trail, unpowered, a random spin; blows up 200 to 399 ticks on, or at once, stopped dead, for a torpedo or a ship the order's data byte says may not spin; a fireball of its radius

name: explode_burst_init
comment: Style 1: unpowered, its rates and inputs zero, blowing up at once

name: explode_halt_init
comment: Style 2: stopped dead, unpowered, a random spin, blowing up at once; a fireball of its radius, and for a torpedo five more and a shockwave

name: explode_spin
comment: The update of styles 0 and 2: while fewer ticks are left than ten a bit of its trail, a small burning bit (explosion_bit, size 0.1, speed 1) thrown backwards from within 250 of it, every other one where flag 24 is set; then the rotation set from the spin times the ticks left times 0.005

name: explode_kill_credit
comment: Where the player destroyed a hostile fighter, or type 0x2D, 0x3C or 0x3E, adds the kill (kills_add) and a radio line on it (radio_kill_remark); a ship with +0x74C clear gets a line of its own (radio_ship_lost)

name: arena_frame
comment: In a multiplayer mission, once a frame: the first time, sizes the arena's sphere round the objects from slot 8 but mines, beacons and a few ranges of types; after, a player's ship that strays past it meets its wall (arena_wall_hit) once until it is back inside, and the local player's is shaken and pushed back in, or put back just inside; the wall's flashes play on and the players' ships are kept apart

name: arena_shot_check
comment: Once the arena is sized, a shot past its sphere meets its wall (arena_wall_hit)

name: arena_wall_hit
comment: Where a shot, which it frees, or a player's ship meets the multiplayer arena's wall: 10 sparks of kind 3 back in from the wall where a flash of it at most 100 ticks old stands within twice its radius, else a new flash (the next of 32, a 4000 mesh facing the arena's middle, for 250 ticks) with the sparks and sound 0xD

name: arena_centre
comment: The middle of the multiplayer arena's sphere

name: arena_radius
comment: The radius of the multiplayer arena's sphere: the farthest reach of the objects it is sized round

name: kills_add
type: void __fastcall (int slot, int count, bool report)
comment: Adds count to a player's kills: skull_count for the local player, the per-player tally, and in a single player mission the mission's own

name: radio_kill_remark
comment: A line on the radio for the player's kill, by the class of what went down, at most once every 600 ticks and not while the radio is busy

name: radio_ship_lost
comment: A line on the radio for a ship lost, but the player's, while the radio is free

name: explode_blast
comment: A ship's blast at the end of Explode: the cloak dropped, the break-up, burning bits, two particle bursts, now and then a shockwave, a fireball, and explosion sound 11, on a sure voice within 20000 of the camera

name: explode_burst
comment: Style 1's blast: the cloak dropped, the break-up, burning bits, two particle bursts and 18 fireballs about it, and explosion sound 11; the player's sets the marker view 0x1B watches, drifting at a quarter of its velocity

name: explode_break_up
comment: Cuts each part node (kind 1) of the tree in four (model_slice, frame the root) and sends the pieces off as debris away from the ship: the first and fourth whole, turning up to 0.02 a tick, trailing smoke (0x00553358 for a blast, 0x00553354 for a burst) for 200 to 499 ticks; the second cut again in two and the third in four, turning up to cuts times 0.025 (blast) or 0.005 (burst), for up to 299 ticks (blast) or 300 to 599 (burst); then the node's children

name: model_slice
comment: Cuts part's drawn mesh along cuts random planes through frame's origin: each polygon to the side the sum of its corners, in frame, lies on; each side a new mesh of its own corners in frame's orientation, centred on their mean, drawn with part's flags and 0x4000, standing there; copies each plane's normal only and makes every polygon plain

name: debris_add
comment: The next of the 500 records of the debris table at 0x0055AE88 (0x40 bytes each: until, stage, object, velocity a tick, spin a tick, smoke emitter), round from 0x0055AD1C, freeing what was there (debris_free)

name: explosions_update
comment: Once a frame: moves the marker on by its drift while it moves, then the explosions' tables: the Uber Explode (0x00473210), rock chunks, streaming emitters, flickering lights, scripted effects, the break-up's debris, which ends in a fireball, then explosion_fireballs, each playing on: the bang's 16 textures or the sheet's 9 cells, drifting, coloured by how far it has played where it is lit, its light fading from 10

name: uber_explode_start
type: void __fastcall (int owner, Vec3 *at, float *orientation, float size, int duration)
comment: The Uber Explode, the Huuuuuuuge Explosion order's: lists into uber_caught every object within 5 times size but the player, which is created and not disabled, with combat stats of a side but neutral and orders, and not a gate, the Boridin or its breakaway, running past the list's end with more than 80; makes the halves of uber_hemisphere, the ball (sphere_mesh_create) and its glow (Uber BMO, the gunflare partic6 texture), and two squares and a light it never adds to the scene; plays UBEREXP at the owner, flashes the screen for 100 ticks and sets off two shockwaves of kind 3, 16 and 6 times size across, over a quarter and a half of the duration

name: uber_explode_update
comment: First in explosions_update: past its duration the Uber Explode ends (uber_explode_free), plays CAPEXP at the owner, destroys each object the ball reached unless it is exploding, and raises the owner's explosion event; until half way the halves grow to 1.3 times size, open out until 0.3 (uber_hemisphere_open), and brighten and fade; from 0.3 the ball spreads to 5 times size, flickering, sets hit_shake, and knocks, spins, sets alight and stops each listed object it reaches; from 0.95 the screen flashes; from half way 12 to 24 burning bits a frame fly at the camera

name: uber_explode_free
comment: Frees the Uber Explode's objects: the halves, the squares, the ball, the light and the glow

name: uber_hemisphere_open
comment: Lays the hemisphere's vertices out share of the way open: its rings share of pi/16 apart round from the pole at the origin, the bowl toward -Z

name: uber_hemisphere_create
comment: The Uber Explode's hemisphere, fully open: a pole, seven rings of 18 and a last pole no triangle uses, 234 triangles over ring3, lit and blended by alpha

name: ease_linear
type: float10 (int unused, float from, float to, float at)
comment: From from to to in a straight line by at

name: event_post_explosion
comment: Queues explosion_ship on the object's mission ship, where it has one

name: light_free
comment: Unlinks a light and frees it

name: uber_started
comment: The frame_start the Uber Explode went off at

name: uber_duration
comment: How many ticks the Uber Explode lasts

name: uber_size
comment: How far the Uber Explode reaches: it lists the objects within 5 times it

name: uber_owner
comment: The slot of the object whose Uber Explode it is

name: uber_caught
comment: The objects the Uber Explode lists, -1 after the last; the ball adds 1000 to each it reaches

name: uber_halves
comment: The Uber Explode's halves, UberHemi1 and UberHemi2; null while none goes off

name: uber_waves
comment: The Uber Explode's squares, UberWave1 and UberWave2, which it never adds to the scene

name: uber_ball
comment: The Uber Explode's ball of flame

name: uber_light
comment: The Uber Explode's light, UberExplosion_Light, which it never adds to the scene

name: uber_glow
comment: The Uber Explode's glow, Uber BMO

name: uber_hemisphere
comment: The hemisphere mesh the Uber Explode's halves share, which explosions_init makes

name: explosion_fireball
type: void __fastcall (Vec3 *at, Vec3 *velocity, int kind, float size, int life, bool light, int delay, bool lit, bool special)
comment: Sets a fireball off in the first free of explosion_fireballs: a sprite of the size at, kind 0 playing explosion_bang_images, 1 the cells of explosion_sheet_image, mirrored by two random bits, blended over what is behind; drifting at velocity, after delay ticks, for life; with a light (1, 0.5, 0.1) of intensity 10 reaching 50 times the square root of the size, where asked

name: explosion_bit
type: int __fastcall (Vec3 *at, Vec3 *direction, float body_chance, float size, float speed, bool rock)
comment: Throws a burning bit into the next of explosion_bits: a rock chunk where asked, a body by the chance (scale 2.5, or 0.75 at size 0.1 or less), otherwise a piece of debris (half to one and a half times size); along direction at 1500 to 4500 a second, strayed up to a quarter radian about each axis, times speed; tumbling up to 0.05 a frame about each axis; for 1750 to 2250 ticks; the splits ask for bodies by their sequence, the Ulysses at 0.1, none for a rock

name: explosion_piece_load
comment: The first levels of debris type 0x4E plus n, their distances stretched by 1.5, for explosions_init

name: explosion_body_load
comment: The first levels of crewman type 0x58 plus n, their distances stretched by 2.5, for explosions_init

name: explosion_pieces
comment: The ten debris models a burning bit is picked from

name: explosion_bodies
comment: The four crewman models a burning bit may be; explosion_bit picks the first three

name: rock_chunk_throw
comment: Throws a rock chunk into the next of the 300 at 0x00558778, tumbling, along a direction with a small special fireball; a split Latov throws them in place of burning bits, and an asteroid hit (shieldfx kind 5)

name: rock_chunks
comment: 300 rock chunks of 0x20 bytes that rock_chunk_throw fills and explosions_update flies

name: explosion_bit_free
comment: Frees a bit's mesh object and counts one fewer

name: explosion_fireballs
comment: Thirty fireballs, 0x2C bytes each: the sprite set, its light, its velocity, its birth, life, look (bit 2 the bang, bits 0 and 1 the mirrors), delay, whether it is lit, and whether it is special

name: explosion_bits
comment: Up to 500 burning bits, 0x28 bytes each: birth, life, kind (1 debris, 2 a body), the mesh object, velocity a second and spin a frame; as many in use as the detail setting allows (100, 300, 500)

name: explosion_bit_next
comment: The slot of explosion_bits the next bit takes, wrapping at the detail's count

name: explosion_bit_count
comment: How many bits fly; nothing reads it

name: explosion_bits_moved_at
comment: The frame_start the bits last moved on at

name: explosion_bang_images
comment: The bang's frames, explosion\bang_00000 to bang_00015

name: explosion_sheet_image
comment: Nine frames in a three by three sheet, explosion\explosion sheet

name: object_retire
comment: What Explode leaves of an object: type 1001, flagged no_collisions, exploding, stand_in, frozen and unpowered, not targetable, and no orders

name: explode_marker
comment: The frame camera view 0x1B watches: where the player's ship burst

name: explode_marker_drift
comment: How far explode_marker moves a frame: a quarter of the ship's velocity

name: explode_marker_moving
comment: Set once explode_burst has placed explode_marker

name: cloak_drop
comment: Drops an object's cloak: its nodes' callbacks freed (cloak_node_free), the cloaked flag cleared and its record freed

name: vec3_lerp
comment: out = from + (to - from) * share

name: mission_ending
comment: How the mission is ending: 0 while it goes on, 1 the player's ship destroyed or the ejected pilot killed, 2 the ejected pilot picked up by a nanny ship, 3 picked up by the enemy, 8 the player ejecting until the pod's time is up (order_eject settles it by the rescue odds); mission_end_record keeps the pilot's kills for every ending but 1 and 3; the debriefing names the ending by it

name: component_damage
type: void __fastcall (GameObject *object, ModelNode *node, float damage, int attacker, DamageKind kind)
comment: Damages a component: lowers its node's armor, records the attacker in last_attacker, and marks the component's holder destroyed once the armor is below zero

name: object_cloak
comment: Cloaks an object: sets its cloaked flag, posts the Cloaked event and sets up the cloak state at +0x63C

name: object_set_targetable
comment: Sets or clears the object's targetable flag; it stays clear when the word at +0x24 of the combat stats is zero

name: ai_steer
type: bool __fastcall (int slot, Vec3 *point, float limit, float ease, uint flags)
comment: The AI's steering: turning inputs toward point, less (1 - ease) * 6 times each turn rate, times 11.46, held within limit. Flags 1 and 2 run avoid_near and avoid_ahead first, 4 rolls upright, 8 keeps pitch at 0.2 or more. Returns whether avoidance took over

name: avoid_near
comment: Moves the point a ship steers at around the objects in its first avoidance list (+0x6B8) it closes on within 250 steps: onto the nearest face of their box, widened twice by its radius, at the corner nearest the point; false when there is nothing to avoid or the ship has no_avoidance

name: avoid_ahead
comment: Moves the point a ship steers at around the objects in its second avoidance list (+0x6E4), taken where they will be by the time the ship reaches them at its cruise speed: within 1000 (500 of another side) of the line, the point goes that far ahead, above or below by both radii and 2000 (1000); not for ships with components

name: ai_roll_upright
comment: Rolls the ship toward the world's Y axis, through 0x403090

name: order_target_valid
comment: Whether an order's target, or a record laid out like one, can still be aimed at: a targetable object not cloaked, exploding, disabled or ejected nor with flag 0x10000000, except the flags in allowed, and a component that is there and neither hidden nor 0x10

name: object_random
comment: The object's own random number from 0 to 1: its seed steps as seed * 0x343FD + 0x269EC3, and bits 16 to 30 of it over 32767 are the number

name: object_stop
comment: Stops an object dead: velocity, speed, throttle, inputs and rates zero, and no rotation

name: object_toggle_cloak
comment: Cloaks or uncloaks an object whose model can cloak

name: object_set_cloak
comment: Cloaks or uncloaks an object, and the ships being launched from it

name: object_uncloak
comment: Uncloaks an object

name: cloak_node_reveal
comment: A hit at a point shows a cloaked node's hull round it, where the node cloaks (cloak_node_cloaks): each vertex of its drawn level within 1.123 of the object's radius (a Kafelnikof part's smallest extent) gains alpha in its frame's own colours (+0x110), the more the nearer, over 0.45 of it, up to 1; then its children

name: cloak_node_see_through
comment: A node that cloaks is drawn by the cloak: its frame takes the hull callback (cloak_hull_callback) and the see-through levels of the part's mesh set (+0x160, +0x18C), its own colours cleared; then its children

name: cloak_node_restore
comment: A node that cloaks has its own levels back (+0x10C, +0x138), alpha 1 and its own colours cleared; then its children

name: cloak_node_shimmer
comment: A node that cloaks gets its shimmer at +0x0C: an object of the cloak's meshes (cloak_mesh_build), clear, its texture coordinates random in 0 to 1, drawn through cloak_shimmer_callback; then its children

name: cloak_shimmer_swirl
type: void __fastcall (ModelNode *node, int ticks, float strength, bool children)
comment: A node's shimmer, ticks since it was drawn: each texture coordinate turns about (0, 0) by 0.008 a tick over its squared distance from there, and each vertex takes cloak_colour at strength, unlit; with children, theirs too

name: cloak_colour_at
comment: The shimmer's colour: from black to (185, 203, 82) / 256 by cosine_ease as strength goes to 0.3, then on to (0, 0, 80) / 256

name: cloak_colour
comment: The shimmer's colour at strength, from cloak_colours

name: cloak_hull_fade
type: void __fastcall (ModelNode *node, int ticks, float solid, bool children)
comment: A node's hull, ticks since it was drawn: while it is clear (solid 0), what hits showed of it fades by 0.01 a tick, else its alpha is solid; with children, theirs too

name: cloak_node_free
comment: Frees the records of a node's cloak callbacks, for its frame and its shimmer, and clears the callbacks; then its children

name: cloak_init
comment: Fills cloak_colours from cloak_colour_at, a step of 1/1024, and requires cloak64 into cloak_texture

name: cloak_free
comment: Releases cloak_texture

name: cloak_frame
comment: In the pass that draws the objects, for an object with a cloak: what its shimmer and hull were drawn at moves back a frame; over 250 ticks the shimmer strengthens and the hull fades, or the other way as it goes; come on, every node's hull is clear and its shimmer whole; gone, each node is restored and the cloak dropped

name: cloak_wobble
comment: But for the Kafelnikof, while the cloak changes, the root frame shears by 0.15 at most, three ways at rates 20, 26 and 14 with starts 0, 2.8 and 0.9 over the change, swelling and dying away as sin(done * pi)

name: cloak_reveal
comment: A hit on a cloaked object at a point: the cloak's struck time is now, and its nodes show their hull there (cloak_node_reveal)

name: cloak_shimmer_callback
comment: The shimmer's per-object callback: unless paused, swirls it (cloak_shimmer_swirl) for the ticks since it was drawn, or skips it (0x100) while the shimmer is nothing or on the Kafelnikof

name: cloak_hull_callback
comment: The hull's per-object callback: skipped (0x100) on the software renderer; else, unless paused or the node doesn't cloak, fades it (cloak_hull_fade) for the ticks since it was drawn

name: cloak_node_cloaks
comment: Whether a node cloaks: every node, but on the Kafelnikof only those named in kafelnikof_cloaking_parts

name: cloak_texture
comment: cloak64, which cloak_init requires and cloak_free releases

name: cloak_colours
comment: The shimmer's colours by strength, which cloak_init fills

name: kafelnikof_cloaking_parts
comment: The Kafelnikof's parts that cloak: Kaf bot vent, Kaf comms twr, Kaf ext vent, Kaf frnt vent, Kaf land plat, Kaf shield gen, Kaf top vent

name: vec3_scale
comment: out = v * s

name: vec3_scale_by
comment: Scales the vector in ECX by s

name: vec3_distance_squared
comment: The square of the distance between two points

name: mission_ticks
comment: Ticks game_tick has run since the mission started, paused ones aside

name: frame_start
comment: mission_ticks when the current frame began

name: frame_duration
comment: Ticks between the previous frame and this one

name: frame_begin
comment: Starts a frame: frame_duration becomes the ticks since frame_start, and frame_start becomes mission_ticks

name: frame_reset
comment: frame_start becomes mission_ticks, and frame_duration zero

name: noop
comment: Returns at once; tables use it for a routine with nothing to do

name: maneuver_compile_line
comment: Compiles a line of a maneuver script into maneuver_code, the first time the line runs: src/engine/game/aidefend/script.zig does the same

name: script_skip_spaces
comment: Skips spaces and tabs

name: script_read_word
comment: Reads a word of letters, digits and _ . : -

name: script_read_arguments
comment: Reads an argument list, (, words separated by commas, ), four words at most; returns the count

name: maneuver_run
comment: Runs the Fight order's maneuver for an update: starts lines until one waits, compiling each the first time, then runs the waiting one

name: maneuver_start_timer
comment: The start of most waiting instructions: their time is up min + random * (max - min) ticks after frame_start

name: maneuver_jump
comment: The start of Goto and Else: goes on after the instruction's line

name: maneuver_fly_to_point
comment: The run of Runaway and Outofactionsphere: steers at the state's point until the time is up

name: maneuver_stop_weaving
comment: Clears weaving

name: maneuver_steer_to_point
comment: Steers at the state's point at full throttle; once the point is nearly dead ahead it pitches at full rate until the point is 45 degrees off, weaving. With anything to avoid, ai_steer with flags 3 instead

name: mat3_forward
comment: out = the third column of m: for an orientation, the forward axis

name: vec3_normalize
comment: Scales v to length 1, or makes it a tiny forward vector when it has none

name: maneuver_code_end
comment: Where maneuver_compile_line writes the next instruction

name: maneuver_code
comment: The compiled lines of the maneuver scripts, packed as the compiler writes them

name: maneuver_choices
comment: The lists Fight picks a maneuver from, a count and then maneuver numbers, by where the target is from the ship's nose, then where the ship is from the target's

name: pursue_distances
comment: How far off a target Fight pursues it, by the pilot's value 3, before the target's speed scales it

name: wing_second
comment: The mission's second wing, as mission_wings_build lists it. Nothing reads it

name: player_wing
comment: The slots of the player's wing, -1 for none, as mission_wings_build lists it with mission_start putting the player's first: the ships the wing status window shows and the radio's orders go to

name: wing_third
comment: The mission's third wing, as mission_wings_build lists it. Nothing reads it

name: wing_icons
comment: Pairs of a ship type and the shape the wing status window shows it by, which mission_start gives each ship of the player's wing: the twelve ships the player can fly and their twins

name: action_sphere_radius
comment: The action sphere's radius: 220000 from the AI's setup, and where SetActionCentre gives none

name: action_sphere_center
comment: The object the action sphere is around, which fighters away from the fight return to; SetActionCentre moves it

name: fight_choose_maneuver
comment: Chooses the Fight order's next maneuver into its entry's data: by the matchup, then its length

name: fight_choose_by_position
comment: Chooses between fighters: pursue when far, run away when close, else from maneuver_choices by where the two ships are

name: fight_choose_against_massive
comment: Attack massive object, for 20000 ticks, against a target with components

name: fight_choose_out_of_sphere
comment: Out of action sphere, for 500 ticks, for a ship away from the action sphere with no player near

name: fight_choose_as_massive
comment: Attack medium fighter, for 10000 ticks, for a ship with components

name: fight_find_ship_to_run_to
comment: Finds the nearest friendly ship with components and combat class 2 or 3 to run to; false when there is none or the ship is near one already

name: fight_aim
comment: Aims the guns: every aim_interval ticks of the pilot at the target, led where it can be, and reckons its drift as a quarter of the target velocity; moves the aim by it each update, then calls fight_fire

name: fight_call_for_help
comment: Has a ship the player has hurt badly send its nearest fighting wingman at the player

name: fight_fire
comment: Fires for the pilot burst once its pause has passed, with the aim along the nose within fire_spread target radii and the node within a quarter of a laser cannon's range; then locks the first rack that is not a Jack Hammer's on the target within its lock range and 0.7 of the nose, ready (+0x2F) once locked_at has passed, launching one time in five once missile_at has; and with a missile homing on it spends a countermeasure once countermeasure_at has passed

name: fight_update_cloak
comment: Uncloaks the ship when its maneuver asked for no cloak, and cloaks it once cloak_at passes when it asked for one

name: object_spend_countermeasure
comment: Spends one of an object's countermeasures (+0x5EC), the player's with hud_beep 0, or 3 with none left: drops one at its tail at its next place, drifting at a quarter of its velocity plus 5 along its Y axis and 5 back, trailing decoy_particles fore and aft, for 1000 ticks; then, outside a network client, the first missile in record order homing on it undecoyed that rolls under its decoy chance (30 more against a player, 50 more against a pilot whose countermeasures least is 50) chases it. A client takes the host's missile

name: SR_init
comment: Clears sr_context and returns it

name: sr_context
comment: Surrender's state: the device, its texture limits, the palette and colour cube in use

name: sr
comment: What SR_init returned: sr_context

name: renderer_start
comment: Starts Surrender on a device: palette and colour cube, texture size cap from texture_detail, texture cache

name: texture_detail
comment: Tdetail in the Device section of the settings: 0, 1 or 2 caps textures at 128, 256 or 2048

name: texture_cache_open
comment: Reads the header and directory, or starts an empty cache when the file is missing or of another version, or fresh is set

name: texture_cache_close
comment: Unloads every texture and closes the file

name: texture_upload
comment: Fits an image to the device's limits, applies brightness and contrast, converts it and hands it to the device

name: path_file_name
comment: What follows the last \, / or : of a path

name: texture_find
comment: The texture of that file name, ignoring case, its pixels read and uploaded on first use; null when absent

name: texture_add
type: TextureImage * __fastcall (char *name, int width, int height, int bytes, uint flags)
comment: Appends an entry and allocates its pixels. No callers

name: texture_create_transient
type: TextureImage * __fastcall (char *name, int width, int height, int bytes, uint flags)
comment: Makes or remakes an entry kept in memory only

name: texture_commit
comment: Builds a new texture's mipmaps if flagged, keeps its pixels, in memory when transient, else appended to the file with the directory rewritten, and uploads it

name: texture_release
comment: Drops a use; the last frees the pixels

name: textures_unload
comment: Frees the pixels of every texture in use

name: textures_reload
comment: Reads and uploads the pixels of every texture in use again

name: texture_require
comment: texture_find, asserting Could not find image %s on a miss

name: image_pixel_count
comment: Pixels in all of an image's levels; sets levels to 1 without mipmaps

name: image_convert
comment: Converts an image's pixels to another format, through the palette for indices

name: image_build_mipmaps
comment: Converts an image to 32 bits and appends its mipmap levels, down to a smaller side of 2

name: image_adjust
comment: Converts the image in ECX to 32 bits, then scales every byte by 1 + contrast and adds brightness times 256

name: pixel_format_set
type: void __fastcall (PixelFormat *format, uint index, uint alpha, uint red, uint green, uint blue)
comment: A format from masks: 4 bytes a pixel with a bit above 15, else 2 with one above 7, else 1

name: pixel_format_shifts
comment: Each channel's shift and loss from its mask

name: SR_TGA_get_palette
comment: Copies the first 256 colour map entries of a colour-mapped TGA, as red, green, blue

name: SR_TGA_allocate_palette
comment: Loads an 8-bit TGA and returns its palette

name: SR_CCB_load
comment: Loads a colour cube: a palette and a 64x64x64 table of indices

name: static_lights_mark
comment: Sets part flag 0x40 on the parts of each class, damaged or not, that holds a static light: an attachment of kind 4 with a range and no blinking

name: static_lights_bake
comment: Bakes each static light into the meshes of every level of the parts of its class

name: static_light_bake
comment: Adds a static light to the baked colours of a part's level

name: light_create
type: void * __thiscall (float x, float y, float z, float pitch, float yaw, float roll)
comment: Allocates a light object, 0xDC bytes, at a position and turned by three angles; the caller sets its kind and the rest

name: SR_object_concate_parents
comment: An object's place in the world at +0x4C and +0x70: its own, after its parent's, once a frame

name: mesh_build
comment: A part's mesh for one level of detail: a group with a material of its own for each run of faces with the same shading and material

name: mesh_create
type: void * __fastcall (int polygons, int vertices, int indices, uint flags)
comment: Allocates a mesh, zeroed

name: mesh_object_create
comment: A scene object of type 1 showing a set of levels (count, distances, meshes) or, without one, a single mesh; its face mask starts all ones, and it takes colours of its own when the mesh has flag 0x1000

name: SR_mesh_set_poly_flags
comment: Each polygon's flags become flags & keep | set. No callers

name: cloak_mesh_build
comment: The mesh the cloak effect draws for a part's level: one surface, textured by coordinates from the normals, lit on hardware, added

name: SR_mesh_calc_vertex_normals
comment: Each vertex normal as the normalized sum of the planes of the polygons using it

name: loadout_ship_models
comment: Set while the loadout screen loads the ship models: mesh_build looks up their textures as g and the material's name

name: loadout_weapon_models
comment: Set while the loadout screen loads the missile and gun models: mesh_build looks up their textures as r and the material's name

name: model_multiplayer_ship
comment: Set while model_load loads a ship type's model in a multiplayer mission, which then gets the cloak mesh sets

name: multiplayer_mission
comment: Unverified: set for missions 81 to 85 and 87, which look like the multiplayer maps, and by the Zone launcher's status

name: sr_render
comment: Draws a frame with sr_draw_layers, then counts it and its time

name: sr_draw_layers
comment: Begins the scene; for each layer, runs each object through its pipeline and the device, then sorts and flushes the layer's blended polygons; ends the scene

name: SR_meshpipe_init
comment: Culls, projects and lights a mesh object's vertices for the frame; non-zero when nothing is left to draw

name: sprite_set_create
comment: A scene object of type 4 holding sprites that share a material: mesh coordinates, unlit, added, no texture until given one; each spans its whole texture

name: SR_bmopipe_init
comment: The pipeline for a set of sprites (srBMO.cpp): each sprite's rectangle in view units, those at least a pixel across and in view listed; non-zero when none is

name: SR_object_rotate
comment: An object in the camera's frame: its origin, and its orientation times the camera's transposed, scaled

name: object_view_test
comment: An object's bounding sphere against the view: non-zero when outside it or smaller than a pixel; every clip plane when it crosses a side

name: object_level_select
comment: Picks a mesh object's level of detail by depth over the detail divisor, and how far it has moved toward the next; then, when clipping, tests the level's bounding box

name: mesh_list_marked
comment: Lists the vertices mesh_cull marked

name: mesh_transform_clipped
comment: Turns the marked vertices into the camera's frame and notes the planes each lies outside

name: mesh_cull_clipped
comment: Drops the polygons wholly outside a plane and notes the planes the rest cross

name: mesh_project_clipped
comment: Lists the vertices still marked and projects those inside the view

name: screen_clamp
comment: Keeps a projected point within the viewport

name: SR_mesh_calc_poly_normals
comment: Each polygon's plane: its unit normal and the normal's dot product with its first corner

name: SR_mesh_find_bounding_box
comment: The mesh's bounding box and its farthest vertex from the origin

name: mesh_texel_areas
comment: For each polygon of a textured group, twice its area in texture space, in texels

name: triangle_area_xy
comment: A triangle's signed area in the XY plane

name: fan_merges
comment: Whether a fan's records all have normals within a dot product of 0.999 of its first's, so mesh_build merges them into one polygon

name: line_pipe
comment: The pipeline for scene objects of kind 5 (srline.cpp): projects the object's vertices, keeping a clip code for each, and marks each segment whose two ends are off the same side. Dead in the shipped game: nothing creates an object of kind 5, and the driver leaves sr+0x5C null

name: balls_pipe
comment: The pipeline for scene objects of kind 6 (srballs.cpp): projects the object's place and scales its radius by the perspective. Dead in the shipped game: nothing creates an object of kind 6, and the driver leaves sr+0x60 null

name: streak_clip
comment: Cuts a star's streak to the view's bounds; -1 when it lies wholly outside one

name: dust_streak_project
comment: Cuts a mote's streak to the near plane, projects both ends, and cuts it to the view

name: sr_round
comment: x rounded to the nearest whole number

name: mesh_cull
comment: Lists each group's polygons that face the camera, with the face mask applied to polygon flags, and marks their vertices

name: mesh_project
comment: Turns the marked vertices into the camera's frame and projects them; depth is sqrt(1/z), scaled

name: mesh_light
comment: Vertex colours: the object's colour and ambient lights, baked colours, then point and directional lights, clamped to 1

name: mesh_generated_coordinates
comment: mesh_sphere_map for each pass the object's flags 0x200 and 0x400 ask for

name: mesh_sphere_map
comment: A pass's texture coordinates from the vertex normals turned into the camera's frame: 0.5 + 0.5 * x, 0.5 + 0.5 * y

name: depth_sort
comment: Radix-sorts a layer's blended polygons by depth key, farthest first

name: SR_mesh_pointlight
comment: Adds a point light to the vertex colours: its colour times intensity, the cosine, and (1 - r/R) squared

name: SR_mesh_dirlight
comment: Adds a directional light to the vertex colours: its colour times intensity and the normal's dot product with its forward axis

name: detail_divisor
comment: Depths are divided by this before choosing a level of detail. mission_frame raises it by 0.05 while frame_time is under 1/40 s and lowers it by 0.5 while over 1/30 s (1/60 and 1/40 at detail 2), within 0.75 to 1.5, 1 to 2 or 1.5 to 3 by the detail setting

name: frame_vertices
comment: The vertices of the mesh objects drawn so far this frame; SR_meshpipe_init leaves out an object that would take it past 19999

name: frame_polygons
comment: The polygons of the mesh objects drawn so far this frame, likewise limited to 19999

name: light_maps
comment: Lmaps in the Device section of the settings, default 1: light maps and highlights

name: backdrop_create
comment: Builds the star fields from space.tga, the dust, the lights and the sun's sprites

name: backdrop_place
comment: Aims the sun, the key lights and the dome from the sun marker, and the fill lights and the nebula from the nebula marker

name: backdrop_reset_streaks
comment: Makes every star field take this frame as its last, so a cut draws no streaks

name: backdrop_frame
comment: Adds the lights, star fields, dust, sun and lens flares to the scene, placing the flares and sizing the sun's sprites

name: scene_add
comment: Pushes an object onto its layer's list, lights onto list 3 and type 8 onto list 4; mission_frame empties the lists each frame

name: object_unlink
comment: Takes an object out of whichever scene list holds it

name: SR_object_add
comment: Pushes an object onto the list its type names. No callers

name: stars_create
comment: A star field: untextured, lit and added

name: stars_project
comment: Projects a star field for the frame, with last frame's positions for streaks; non-zero when none shows

name: nebula_dome_software
comment: The software renderer's sky dome: a 20x10 band at radius 1000

name: nebula_dome
comment: The sky dome: a 15x8 band at radius 5000, coloured from starref12.tga

name: nebula_create
comment: Builds the sky dome and both nebula patches

name: nebula_select
comment: Shows the nebula nebula_requested names: its texture, its fill light colour, and the smaller patch for nebula 5

name: nebula_frame
comment: Centres the dome and the nebula on the camera and adds them to the background layer

name: sky_patch_create
type: void * __fastcall (void *texture, int columns, float radius, float pitch_min, float pitch_max, float yaw_min, float yaw_max, int rows)
comment: A textured patch of a sphere around the camera: unlit and added

name: environment_effect_set
comment: Sets or clears an environment effect's bit and runs its handler; Ice Field and Planet Bombard have none

name: environment_update
comment: Applies a pending nebula choice, object flag 0x400 changes and environment effect changes

name: SR_TGA_allocate_raw
comment: A TGA's pixels, top row first; 24-bit ones widened to 4 bytes

name: mat3_look_at
comment: An orientation whose forward axis points from one point to another: turned about Y, then X, then rolled

name: mat3_turn_y
comment: Turns the matrix in ECX about Y

name: mat3_turn_x
comment: Turns the matrix in ECX about X

name: mat3_turn_z
comment: Turns the matrix in ECX about Z

name: sr_atan2
comment: The angle whose tangent is y / x, from a table

name: light_key_01
comment: The key light for models whose objects list components (mask 0x01)

name: light_fill_02
comment: The fill light for models whose objects list components (mask 0x02)

name: light_ambient_04
comment: Ambient, 0.04 (mask 0x04)

name: light_key_08
comment: The key light for the other models (mask 0x08)

name: light_fill_10
comment: The fill light for the other models, at 0.7 (mask 0x10)

name: light_ambient_20
comment: Ambient, 0.09 (mask 0x20)

name: sun_sprites
comment: sunlayer1, sunlayer3, six lens flares, sunlayer2

name: nebula_patch_small
comment: Nebula 5's

name: nebula_requested
comment: Set by SetEnvironmentFXNebula, shown by environment_update

name: nebula_fill_colours
comment: Red, green and blue for each of the seven nebulae

name: environment_effects
comment: Thirteen 32-byte entries: switch-on and switch-off handlers, then a name

name: timer_ticks
comment: Every tick of the timer, the paused ones included; tick_timer advances it before it looks at paused

name: paused_ticks
comment: Ticks game_tick has skipped while the game is paused

name: simulation_counter
comment: game_tick calls since the simulation step last did its work, which it does on the fourth

name: simulation_turn
comment: The object whose orientation simulation_step orthonormalizes this step; moves on by one each step and goes round the live objects

name: node_mount_glow
comment: Makes an engine glow node, kind 2, for an attachment of kind 2: its mesh is the Engine Mesh, and its cull radius the largest of the attachment sizes

name: node_mount_light
comment: Makes the nodes of a light attachment (kind 4): kind 3, its two sprites, where the attachment has a width; kind 5, a point light, where it blinks and has a brightness

name: node_tree_update
comment: Once each simulation step for each live object, before the objects move: walks from the root into children that are animating (flag 0x800), not hidden and not flagged 0x80. Each node commits a pending next place (the 0x48-byte block at +0x5C over +0x14, clearing flag bit 0 and setting bits 1 and 2), moves its track time on by its speed in its mode (1 once, 2 looping, 3 back and forth), poses it with node_animate, and sets off the events whose times it passed

name: node_animate
comment: Sets a node's animated offset and angles from its part's animation track at a time, taken between the keyframes either side of it, or from the last where the time runs past them; a node whose track index is past the part's tracks takes none. Then node_place works its place out

name: node_place
comment: Works a part node's next place out in the frame of the node it hangs from, from its pose: the track's angles, less those about the axes the part flags at +0xC8, plus the turret's at +0xDC, and the track's offset. The part's origin plus the offset, less the origin of its parent's part or the object's centre, turned about the part's mount point by the transpose of its orientation times the angles' turn times its orientation. Sets flag bits 0 and 3

name: engine_glow_create
comment: Gives an engine glow node its mesh object: the mesh engine_glow_meshes holds for its attachment's id, clamped to 1 to 7

name: engine_glow_mesh_build
comment: Builds one of the seven engine glow meshes: a unit quad across the nozzle on the kind's matflarea texture, then three blades a unit long, 60 degrees apart about the plume, on its matflareb one; both added and unlit, every polygon biased 10 nearer, and the texture taken from 0.04 to 0.99

name: engine_glows_build
comment: Takes the fourteen flare textures into engine_glow_flares, builds the seven meshes into engine_glow_meshes, and sets engine_glows_built; does nothing once built

name: engine_glows_free
comment: Frees the seven engine glow meshes and clears engine_glows_built

name: engine_glow_meshes
comment: The engine glow mesh for each attachment id, which the glow reads at id clamped to 1 to 7; slot 0 is unused

name: engine_glow_flares
comment: The flare textures each glow wears, read at its attachment id clamped to 1 to 7: matflarea1 to matflarea7 for the nozzle quad, matflareb1 to matflareb7 for the blades; slot 0 is unused

name: engine_glows_built
comment: Set once engine_glows_build has made the glow meshes, so that it makes them only once

name: skull_count
comment: The pilot's kills over the campaign, which kills_add counts and the display's skull readout shows. The end of a mission the player comes through keeps it in skull_count_kept and promotes the pilot by it (mission_end_record); WinMain puts it back from there before each single-player mission, undoing a failed attempt's kills; a new pilot starts it from 0 (0x004751B0)

name: player_jump
comment: JUMP DRIVE, while 0x00588394 is 0: when the mission has a jump or a warp ready (jump_ready, warp_ready), clears it and posts player_ready_to_jump or player_ready_to_warp

name: player_ecm_set
comment: Turns the player's ECM on or off, when the ship carries one (ecm_state not -1): object flag 0x4000000 and ecm_state

name: player_cloak_set
comment: Cloaks or uncloaks the player's ship through object_set_cloak, outside a multiplayer game, when its model can cloak (header flag 2) and cloak_state is not -1

name: order_eject_player_init
comment: The init of order 118, Eject Player: marks the ship ejected (object flags 0x808), sets mission_ending to 8, sets player_ejected and starts the eject marker's flash

name: palette_to_vfx
comment: Makes VFX's global palette of a palette of 6-bit levels at a brightness, under the hardware renderers or on a pane of more than 8 bits: at a brightness of 1 each level is shifted up by two

name: hud_icon_lit
comment: Whether ShowHudIcon has an icon lit this frame: state 1 always, state 2 for the first 50 ticks of every 100, the count carrying what runs past 100 over

name: hud_jump_prompt
comment: Flashes the warp icon (shape 0xC9) or else the jump icon (0xCE) above the middle of the screen while warp_ready or jump_ready says one is ready; the frame one becomes ready (1) it moves it to 2 and starts the flash

name: hud_eject_marker
comment: Flashes shape 0xC2, the pilot rising out of the ship, under the middle of the screen while player_ejected is set or ShowHudIcon lights icon 5

name: hud_free
comment: Frees what hud_init allocated and clears the flag that lets it run again; the device's teardown calls it

name: hud_scanner
comment: While scanner_object names an object, draws shapes 0xD1 to 0xD5 in turn at the middle of the screen, moving on once game_ticks is past hud_scanner_next

name: hud_ship_status
type: void __fastcall (int slot, int mode, void *pane, int x, int y)
comment: The ship status indicator: a ship's schematic (type_data shape 0), the quadrants hits have worn flashing on it as shapes 1 to 4, and its shields and armour as two rings of four arcs, five shapes each, the shields' 0x99 to 0xAC outside, the armour's 0x85 to 0x98 inside, each level the quadrant over shield_power or armor_class, cut down, less one, and an invulnerable ship's armour (2 * level + 6) / 3. Mode 0 draws the player's own ship, with its ship_status_hits for a type of the small target display and the arcs of what SHIELD BALANCING shifted. Mode 1 draws the target in the target display's small form: for a type of the small form its schematic and target_status_hits, mirrored across unless the type is hostile, and its arcs mirrored with left and right swapped. A comms relay or a deathmatch beacon has no arcs, and a stand-in target closes window 3

name: hud_target_keys
comment: The targeting and missile keys, which frame_controls runs after the camera's: TARGET TORPEDO, the nearest and next targets, the subtargets, TARGET UNDER RETICULE, MISSILE WINDOW, the missile ring, and SMART TARGET, which flips smart_targeting

name: hud_subtarget
comment: The subtarget: walks the target's assembly by link_id. Not read in full

name: hud_beep
comment: Plays the display's sound n, sample 15 + n of bank_stdsmp, while the camera is in one of the four cockpit views; 4 and 5 are a device turning on and off

name: hud_palette_ramp
comment: Sets entries 1 to 15 of VFX's global palette, or on an 8-bit pane menu_text_remap, to a ramp of a colour: entry i is the colour times i/15 times palette_ramp_brightness. The pause menu's text draws with them

name: hud_colour
type: uint __fastcall (int red, int green, int blue)
comment: A colour as the display's pane holds one: looked up through the renderer's 6-6-6 table on an 8-bit pane, or shifted into the pixel format

name: hud_interference_start
comment: Sets hud_interference to 0.3 and, no more than every 15 to 29 ticks, plays sound 12 at the player's ship through 0x00482160. Called from 0x00463EE0 and 0x004641F0

name: hud_interference_fade
comment: Lowers hud_interference by 0.005 for each tick since it last ran, to nothing

name: missiles_update
comment: Once a frame after the objects are framed: runs each live missile's order update; within its flight time tests it for contact (missile_collide) and, with none, frames and draws it by its throttle and sets missile_homing (+0x64C) on its target, with no decoy, but not for a player's Screamer outside multiplayer; past its flight time ends it. Then each trail's updates by its look's flags. In multiplayer, drops the target of a player's missile whose lock broke and ends one whose launcher is gone

name: jump_ready
comment: Whether the mission has a jump ready for JUMP DRIVE: 1 when it becomes ready, 2 once hud_jump_prompt shows it; player_jump clears it

name: warp_ready
comment: As jump_ready, for a warp, which the prompt shows first

name: hud_shapes
comment: The display's shapes: hudhard.spr under the hardware renderers, hudsoft.spr under the software one

name: hud_icons
comment: ShowHudIcon's table: twenty icons, each a state (0 off, 1 on, 2 flash) and the count its flash is at. hud_init turns them off; the display reads icons 0 to 5

name: spectral_shields_charge
comment: The spectral shields' charge in ticks, 6000 when full: it drains 6 a tick while they are on and fills 1 a tick while off; hud_draw turns them off when it runs dry

name: cloak_state
comment: -1 when the player's ship has no cloak, else 0 off and 1 on. The mission's start sets 0 for a ship whose model can cloak; object_set_cloak sets it for the player

name: cloak_charge
comment: The cloak's charge in ticks, 10000 when full: it drains and fills 1 a tick, outside a multiplayer game; hud_draw uncloaks the ship when it runs dry

name: ecm_charge
comment: The ECM's charge in ticks, 2000 when full: it drains and fills 1 a tick; hud_draw turns the ECM off when it runs dry

name: hud_prompt_ticks
comment: The count hud_jump_prompt flashes by

name: hud_scanner_next
comment: The game tick after which hud_scanner moves on a frame

name: blind_fire_fitted
comment: Whether the player's ship carries blind fire, which the mission's start decides by its type

name: hud_brightness
comment: The brightness hud_draw makes VFX's global palette at: 1, which hud_init and Jump In's end set and nothing changes

name: hud_eject_ticks
comment: The count hud_eject_marker flashes by, which order_eject_player_init starts again

name: smart_targeting
comment: Smart targeting, which SMART TARGET flips (hud_target_keys)

name: player_ejected
comment: Set by order_eject_player_init; while it is, hud_eject_marker flashes

name: enemy_lock
comment: Set by mission_frame when a ship whose order is Fight against the player has byte 0x2F of its fight state set; lights the display's lock warning. Unverified: that the byte is a missile lock

name: blind_fire
comment: Blind fire, which TOGGLE BLINDFIRE flips on a ship that carries it; hud_init and the mission's start turn it on

name: hud_scanner_frame
comment: The frame of five hud_scanner draws

name: dm_icons
comment: dmicons.spr, or soft_dmicons.spr under the software renderer, which hud_init loads. Unknown: what draws it

name: hud_warning_ticks
comment: The count the lock and missile warnings flash by, which the two share

name: spectral_shields_state
comment: -1 when the player's ship has no spectral shields, else 0 off and 1 on. The mission's start sets 0 for the Nagi, the Crusader, the Tempest and the Shroud

name: ecm_state
comment: 0 when the ECM is off and 1 when on; the mission's start sets 0, so every ship carries one. -1 would be none

name: cockpit_frame
comment: The model of the cockpit's frame, which the mission's start loads by the player's ship type

name: scanner_object
comment: The object the Scanner command has the player look for, or -1: hud_scanner draws while it names one, and mission_frame beeps at an interval of 10 to 200 ticks that it works out from the object's distance and bearing

name: hud_interference_sounded_at
comment: The tick hud_interference_start last played its sound at, which it plays again only once more than 15 ticks and a random share of 15 more have passed

name: hud_interference_faded_at
comment: The tick hud_interference_fade last lowered hud_interference at, which it lowers by 0.005 a tick since

name: hud_interference
comment: How much the display is shaken: while above 0, hud_draw draws its shapes with hud_blit. hud_interference_start sets 0.3 and hud_interference_fade lowers it

name: vfx_line_draw
comment: VFX_line_draw, looked up out of the VFX library

name: vfx_shape_multilookaside
comment: VFX_shape_multilookaside, looked up out of the VFX library

name: hud_pane
comment: The VFX pane the display draws into

name: vfx_shape_translate_draw
comment: VFX_shape_translate_draw, looked up out of the VFX library

name: vfx_return_global_palette
comment: VFX_return_global_palette, looked up out of the VFX library

name: vfx_init_global_palette
comment: VFX_init_global_palette, looked up out of the VFX library

name: vfx_shape_draw
comment: VFX_shape_draw, looked up out of the VFX library

name: vfx_shape_draw_mirrored
comment: VFX_shape_draw_mirrored, looked up out of the VFX library

name: vfx_shape_bounds
comment: VFX_shape_bounds, looked up out of the VFX library

name: vfx_shape_origin
comment: VFX_shape_origin, looked up out of the VFX library

name: vfx_shape_resolution
comment: VFX_shape_resolution, looked up out of the VFX library

name: vfx_pane_wipe
comment: VFX_pane_wipe, looked up out of the VFX library

name: language_init
comment: Loads language.dll and reads its string table with LoadStringA, from id 1 up to the first id with no string or an empty one, into language_strings; then reads the module's version language into 0x00563A14

name: language_string
comment: The string of an id out of language_strings; stops the game with the fatal error 'id out of range' for an id past them

name: launch_reliant_run
comment: The Reliant's launch, a step each time its wait has passed: the engine, the cutaway and the upper door; the retainer lowering the player's ship and letting go; the lower doors opening; the drop by motion_downward with the date typed; the cutaway ending; flying ahead again; at the end the cockpit mode from its setting, view 0 again, the order popped, targetable, Launched posted

name: game_pause
comment: Pauses or resumes the mission. Pausing sets paused, holds the frame timing, pauses the voices, hands sr + 0x88 pause_menu_draw in place of hud_draw, opens the menu and, in a session unless quiet, sends the pause; resuming undoes it, puts hud_draw back and, if cockpit_mode_setting changed meanwhile, switches to view 0. The music goes on

name: message_pump
comment: Pumps the window's messages; as the window goes inactive, pauses the music, the 3D voices and the voices and the mission (game_pause) and waits until it is active again, when the sound goes on; 0 on WM_QUIT

name: app_active
comment: Whether the renderer runs: renderer_start sets it and 0x004AD3E0 clears it. The message pump pauses only while it is set

name: app_inactive_paused
comment: Whether message_pump has paused the game for the window going inactive

name: language_strings
comment: The strings language_init reads, by id less one

name: language_count
comment: How many strings language_init read

name: language_module
comment: language.dll, as LoadLibraryA loads it

name: options_cockpit_setting
comment: The options screen's cockpit setting, which it copies to cockpit_mode_setting and writes to the ini as [Device] View

name: hud_damage_bar
type: void __fastcall (void *pane, int x, int y, float level)
comment: A bar of the damage display at x, y for a level from 0 to 1: shape 0xE0 whole, then shape 0xDF at the same place in hud_bar_pane, whose left edge stands a pixel before round(77 * level) along the bar, so that the red shows past the level

name: hud_radar
comment: The radar: the display's nav point, and each object but the display's own ship that is targetable and not exploding, disabled, ejected or a cloaked hostile, within radar_reach of the range radar_range picks; each placed by its offset in the display ship's frame, times radar_scale and 66 across, 43 ahead as up the screen and 30 for the height, which lowers the dot, kept off the screen's last row; into radar_contacts. Then those level with the rings' plane or below it, the rings, hud_radar_rings, at hud_place(1, -51, 0.5, 1) less (0x42, 0x20), and those above it: each a line of pixels a pixel right of its dot to the plane, in palette entry 0xFF for the player's target, 0xFD for the object the radio's window names while it is open, 0x26 for a hostile and 0x62 otherwise, and shape 0x130, 0xE6, 0xE5 or 0xE4 2 right of its dot; the nav point a cross of four pixels in the palette's nearest white

name: hud_radar_zoom
comment: While radar_zooming, steps hud_radar_rings a shape toward radar_zoom_rings, down if radar_zoom_down: whenever game_ticks is short of radar_zoom_next, which it puts 50 ahead as it steps, so once each frame the radar is drawn

name: hud_window_open
comment: Starts a display window opening, not held, if it is shut, and gives it its full time to stay whatever its phase. In a multiplayer game windows 2, 9 and 10 do not open. Returns whether the window is up

name: hud_window_close
comment: Starts a display window that is open or opening closing, from its full size, and lets go of it; for windows 3 and 8, the target display, first draws what they show into hud_window_picture, which they close with

name: hud_window_draw
type: void __fastcall (void *pane, int window, int x, int y)
comment: Draws a display window with its place at x, y: in the view ahead its frame, pieces of hud_window_pieces, then what it shows, by a switch on the window

name: gunnery_wire_frame
comment: The gunnery window's wire frame of the player's ship, a shape of the display's set, which mission_start picks by the ship type, -1 for none; the shapes after it light each group of guns

name: hud_windows
comment: The display's fifteen windows, 40 bytes each: the phase (0 shut, 1 opening, 2 closing, 3 open), the place as fractions of the screen at +0x04 and +0x08, the frame's piece count at +0x0C and their numbers from +0x0E, the ticks left at +0x18 and to stay at +0x1C, how far it has opened, to 60, at +0x20, and whether it is held open at +0x24

name: hud_window_buffer_places
comment: For each display window, where its place falls in hud_window_pane as it opens and closes, a fraction across and down

name: hud_window_pieces
comment: The pieces of the display windows' frames, 20 bytes each: a shape of hud_shapes, its offset from the window's place as two floats, cut to whole numbers when drawn, and at +0x0E and +0x10 the VFX_shape_draw_mirrored mode, 1 across and 2 down

name: hud_window_pane
comment: The 225 by 170 pane hud_init makes, which hud_draw draws a display window into as it opens and closes and then draws onto the display with VFX_buffer_transform, scaled about the window's place

name: hud_window_picture
comment: A second 225 by 170 pane, the picture of the target display hud_window_close keeps for windows 3 and 8 to close with

name: powerball_held
comment: Set while POWERBALL WINDOW is held, and for the frame its locked form opens the power window; the player's controls read it

name: hud_missile_ring
comment: The missile window's ring, an entry of five halfwords for each missile type the player's racks hold: the count left, or -1 for none, its place round the ring, 0 the armed one at six o'clock, the first of its ten shapes, its name's text id, and its type

name: mission_objectives
comment: The objectives of each mission, ten to a mission from mission 1, each its state and the string that names it, which the objectives window shows

name: objectives_shown
comment: Which of the mission's objectives the objectives window shows, which OBJECTIVES WINDOW pages through while the window is open

name: mission_number
comment: The number of the mission being flown, from 1, by which the objectives window finds its objectives; missions 25 and 29 have display rules of their own

name: hud_target_x
comment: Where hud_target's lead cursor stands across the screen, or -1 while none is drawn

name: hud_target_y
comment: Where hud_target's lead cursor stands down the screen, or -1 while none is drawn

name: target_under_reticle
comment: Set while the target stands within 0x10 of the middle of the screen either way, or while blind fire aims at it; the reticle is then drawn bright (0xD8)

name: hud_sight_x
comment: Where blind fire's sight stands across the screen: on the target while blind fire aims at it, gliding back to the middle a pixel a tick otherwise. hud_init puts it at the middle

name: hud_sight_y
comment: Where blind fire's sight stands down the screen, as hud_sight_x

name: hud_target_dx
comment: How far the target stands right of the middle of the screen

name: hud_target_dy
comment: How far the target stands below the middle of the screen

name: hud_radar_rings
comment: The radar's rings: one of shapes 0x161 to 0x16B, 0x161 one ring, 0x166 two and 0x16B three, the ranges' own; 0x16B from hud_init

name: radar_zooming
comment: Set while the radar's rings move to a new range's, which RADAR RANGES starts and hud_radar_zoom ends; RADAR RANGES does nothing meanwhile

name: radar_zoom_rings
comment: The rings shape the radar's rings stop at: 0x161, 0x166 or 0x16B for the range

name: radar_zoom_down
comment: 1 when the radar's rings step down toward radar_zoom_rings, which they do only to range 0

name: radar_zoom_next
comment: The tick hud_radar_zoom steps while game_ticks is short of, which RADAR RANGES and each step put 50 ahead

name: radar_range
comment: The radar's range, 0 to 2, 2 from hud_init, which sets the scales the objects are placed by

name: hud_speed_lit_pane
comment: The VFX pane the speed arc's lit shape (0xB8) is drawn into, cut off above the speed marker each frame

name: hud_speed_unlit_pane
comment: The VFX pane the speed arc's unlit shape (0xB9) is drawn into, cut off below the speed marker each frame

name: hud_charge_lit_pane
comment: The VFX pane the charge arc's lit shape (0xF9) is drawn into, cut off above the guns' charge each frame

name: hud_charge_unlit_pane
comment: The VFX pane the charge arc's unlit shape (0xF8) is drawn into, cut off below the guns' charge each frame

name: hud_object
comment: The object the display shows, game_objects[0x005883AC], which hud_draw takes each frame

name: hud_flip_buffer
