comment: hud_init's 'flip buffer', 0x19000 bytes, which hud_blit and VFX_shape_draw_mirrored draw a shape into first

name: hud_work_buffer
comment: hud_init's 'work buffer', 0x19000 bytes

name: hud_work_buffer2
comment: hud_init's 'work buffer2', 0x19000 bytes

name: vfx_pixel_write
comment: VFX_pixel_write, looked up out of the VFX library

name: vfx_buffer_transform
comment: VFX_buffer_transform, looked up out of the VFX library

name: vfx_pane_construct
comment: VFX_pane_construct, looked up out of the VFX library

name: vfx_shape_lookaside
comment: VFX_shape_lookaside, looked up out of the VFX library

name: cockpit_object
comment: The cockpit's object, which the mission's start makes of cockpit_frame's parts, each drawn always from its finest level and lit through light mask 0x12, and hangs from the camera's frame; camera_frame moves it, and mission_frame draws its first two parts over the world in cockpit mode 1

name: radar_backing
comment: The radar's backing, 'radaralpha': a quad under the radar, a black disc at three quarters, standing in the camera's frame 1000 ahead, which mission_frame draws with the cockpit unless DISPLAY KILLS is held

name: radar_backing_mesh
comment: The radar backing's mesh: four corners from 65 left of the middle to 67 right and 32 either side of the radar's height, unprojected to 1000

name: cockpit_recoil
comment: The guns' kick on the cockpit's hands: 1 as the player's guns fire, a twentieth less each frame; camera_frame moves the hands back 30 times it

name: object_apply_knocks
comment: Applies the knocks taken since the last move and clears them: the impulse over the mass to the velocity, and the angular impulse, through the inverse inertia tensor, to the rotation and the angular rates

name: object_knock
comment: A push of force at a world point, from a collision or an explosion: adds the force to the impulse and force × lever to the angular impulse

name: object_knock_local
comment: object_knock with the force in the object's frame and the lever given directly; the Disrupted order pushes a ship with it

name: vec3_cross
comment: out = a × b

name: vec3_divide_by
comment: Divides the vector in ECX by d, by multiplying it by 1 / d

name: mat3_from_axes
comment: Builds m from a Z axis and an X axis: Z normalized, Y = normalize(Z × X), X = Y × Z

name: mat3_orthonormalize
comment: Makes the axes of m unit length and perpendicular again, keeping the direction of its Z axis

name: mat3_angles
comment: The angles about X, Y and Z that make up m, from sr_atan2

name: mat3_inverse
comment: out = the inverse of m

name: sr_tables_init
comment: Fills atan_table and ease_table, once

name: sr_atan
comment: The angle whose tangent is x, from atan_table

name: sr_ease
comment: (1 - cos(t × pi)) / 2 for t from 0 to 1, from ease_table

name: atan_table
comment: The arctangent of 0 to 1 in steps of 1/4096, for sr_atan and sr_atan2

name: ease_table
comment: (sin((i / 4096 - 0.5) × pi) + 1) / 2, for sr_ease

name: player_speed_change
comment: How much the player's speed changed in the last object_move; nothing reads it

name: motion_downward
comment: The plain flight model along the object's Y axis, which points below it: object_steer without throttle turns, then the velocity through the flight model's inertia toward the throttle times its top speed, the last throttle nothing; a fighter flies by the first ship type's flight model (0x004F9E70). Selected by the Reliant's launch and the Ripper

name: motion_plain
comment: motion_downward along the object's Z axis, keeping the throttle as the last, the Ripper flying by its own flight model whatever its class: a flight model with no throttle rules or burns. Selected by a torpedo's launch, the Ripper and the landing orders

name: motion_brake
comment: Slows the object to 0.97 of its velocity each update. Selected by the Eject order

name: motion_jump_out
comment: Moves the object to the point between the two in its JumpState (+0x5C, +0x68) by the square of 0.004 a tick of mission_ticks since its step began (+0x08), each coordinate eased (0x00426900); no rotation, last throttle nothing. Selected by Jump Out as the ship goes

name: motion_jump_in
comment: Flies the object along its nose at 2400 (600 without components), less 0.003 of that for each tick of frame_start since it was placed (JumpState +0x08), but never slower than its cruise speed; no rotation, last throttle nothing. Selected by Jump In as the ship flies in

name: jump_init
comment: Readies the jumps as a mission loads: makes the flare's mesh (jump_flare_mesh), loads the trails' texture (jump_trail_texture), and clears jump_player_going and jump_arriving

name: jump_free
comment: Frees jump_flare_mesh as a mission ends

name: jump_effect_start
comment: Begins Jump Out's effect as the ship is held still: keeps how the ship is turned and where it stands (+0x18, +0x3C), aims its motion 500000 along the way to its destination (+0x68), and makes its burst behind it, a trail at each attachment of kind 7 (five at most) and a light at each of kind 8 (twenty at most)

name: jump_trail_mesh
comment: Makes a jump's trail mesh (JumpTrail Mesh): 100 by 100 by 20000, or 1000 by 1000 by 40000 for a ship that lists components, flipped for the Ripper

name: model_show_finest
comment: Sets or clears bit 8 of the scene object flags of each node of a model and of the models mounted on it, which draws them at their finest level

name: jump_burst_mesh
comment: Makes a jump's burst mesh (JumpBurst Mesh): six rings of twelve, with the shield texture, for Jump In where arriving and else for Jump Out

name: jump_flare_object
comment: A scene object of jump_flare_mesh (Jump flare mesh), scaled to width

name: jump_burst_fade
comment: Greys a jump burst's rings by their place times share times 0.1, opaque

name: jump_burst_glow
comment: Lights a jump burst, on the hardware renderers and on the software one apart

name: jump_trail_stretch
comment: Stretches a jump's trail, its vertices placed by share times 0.3

name: jump_mark
comment: Marks an object in the way of a formation's Jump Out as jumping, and in turn each fuel pod (type 0xE1) and each ship whose Launch or Dock names it, but stand-ins and disabled and jumping ones

name: jump_out_place
comment: Where Jump Out takes a ship: in formation behind the player's ship when the player's order is Jump Out at the same target, rows 3000 apart, 150 ahead, clearing its way 500000 ahead (jump_mark); else to its target, or 1e7 ahead

name: jump_in_place
comment: Where Jump In brings a ship: abreast of its target where it is drawn, turned as it is, by the order's number 3000 apart to the right and the left in turn

name: jump_effect_alloc
comment: Allocates a jump's effect record, 0x94 bytes, cleared, into the first free of the 64 jump_effects; null when all are taken

name: jump_effect_free
comment: Lets a jump's effect record go (0x004189D0)

name: jump_effects
comment: The jumps' effect records, 0x94 bytes each: trails, lights, burst and flare; Jump In stops with Jump has overrun array when all are taken

name: jump_countdown_step
comment: 1/15, which order_jump_out_init sets and nothing reads

name: jump_flare_mesh
comment: The jump flare's mesh, which jump_init makes

name: jump_trail_texture
comment: The jump trails' texture, which jump_init loads

name: jump_player_going
comment: Set while the player's ship is on its Jump Out, which gates jump_countdown; jump_init and Jump Out's end clear it

name: jump_countdown
comment: 15 from order_jump_out_init, counted down every 10 game ticks while jump_player_going; nothing reads it

name: jump_countdown_next
comment: The game tick past which jump_countdown next counts down

name: jump_arriving
comment: Set while the player's ship jumps in, from Jump In's placing to its flight's end, which cuts the space dust's streaks to a quarter (stars_project); jump_init clears it

name: motion_follow
comment: Steers toward the point the order state's callback gives and moves toward it, no faster than the order state's speed limit. Selected by the Follow Curve and Dock orders

name: motion_follow_backwards
comment: motion_follow with the angles to the point negated, for flying tail first

name: motion_drift
comment: Slows the object to 0.99 of its velocity each update. Selected by the Jump In order

name: power_reach
comment: How far the power setting in ECX is toward the direction (x, y): the distance from it to the edge of the power ball's disc, radius 64, going the other way. 128 at the anchor, 64 in the middle

name: power_distribute
comment: Sets the object's shield, gun and speed factors from its power setting: each system's share of the three reaches, s, gives (1.75 - 0.75 s) s + 0.5

name: shield_balance
comment: SHIELD BALANCING held: past half-way, the stick's y shifts a quarter of the shield power a step between the fore and aft shields, through their reserves

name: power_move
comment: POWERBALL WINDOW held: moves the player's power setting against the stick by the frame's ticks, keeps it within the disc and distributes the power

name: object_recharge_shields
comment: Each simulation step: each shield gains its full charge times the shield factor and condition over the recharge time, up to the full charge, less what SHIELD BALANCING shifted to the other side for the player

name: hud_channel
comment: A colour channel: x cut to a whole number and kept within 0 and 255

name: shield_balancing_held
comment: Set while SHIELD BALANCING is held: the stick shifts the shields instead of steering

name: shield_reserve_aft
comment: What SHIELD BALANCING shifted beyond the aft shield's most

name: shield_reserve_fore
comment: What SHIELD BALANCING shifted beyond the fore shield's most

name: power_ball_texture
comment: powerball.tga, a byte a pixel, each the top 5 bits of the grey

name: power_ball_sphere
comment: Where each pixel of the 62 by 62 power ball shows the texture, a sphere mapped onto it

name: power_ball_shade
comment: How brightly each pixel of the power ball is lit, 0 to 63

name: power_ball_colours16
comment: The power ball's colours in the 16-bit display: 32 for each of 64 levels of light

name: power_ball_colours8
comment: The same for the 8-bit display, as palette indices

name: lerp
type: float __stdcall (float a, float b, float t)
comment: The value t of the way from a to b: (b - a) t + a

name: SR_object_init
comment: Clears a new scene object: identity orientations, zero positions, no name

name: SR_light_init
comment: Readies a new light: frame type 2, intensity 1, range 1. It leaves the kind at +0xB4, which a cleared allocation makes 0, a point light

name: node_mark_animating
comment: Sets flag 0x800, animating, on a node and every node it hangs from, unless the node has it already

name: node_play
type: void __fastcall (ModelNode *node, int slot, float time, int mode, float speed)
comment: Plays on a part node the track its part's loader filed under slot 0 startup, 1 fire or 2 deploy: from time unless it is below zero, in mode, the track's own for -1, at speed a step. Any mode but 0 marks the node animating

name: node_play_named
type: void __fastcall (ModelNode *node, char *name, float time, int mode, float speed)
comment: node_play for the first of the part's tracks with the name, whatever its case

name: node_turn
comment: Turns a node by angles of its own, as a turret turns: adds delta to the angles at +0xDC and marks it animating; about each axis whose limits its part holds (+0xD8 to +0xEC, degrees) keeps the angle within them, or with equal limits brings it round within a half turn

name: node_frame_update
comment: Once a frame: puts a node that a step committed a new place for (flag bits 1 and 2) simulation_counter quarters of the way from that place to the next. A posed node (bit 3) moves between its poses, the angles turning the short way round; any other along the line between and by that share of the turn. Another player's ship in a multiplayer game moves between its last two messages' places instead

name: node_tree_frames
comment: node_frame_update for a node and, in turn, each child that is neither hidden nor flagged 0x80. mission_frame runs it for every object before placing the camera

name: mat3_copy_transposed
comment: Copies the transpose of a 3x3 matrix

name: clip_event_muzzles
comment: A track's event of kind 0: runs 0x0047C5F0 for each of the node's children of kind 4, the nodes attachments of kind 3 make at a gun's muzzle

name: clip_event_particles
comment: A track's event of kind 2: for each attachment of kind 7 on the node's part, emits a particle from the template at 0x005636DC at the attachment's place, with a random frame and a quarter of the object's velocity

name: allied_huge_gun_trail
comment: The particles an Allied Huge Gun's shot trails, of particle_pool: 120 to 129 ticks, 12 a tick, a half-size from 700 to 250, blue fading to nothing

name: coalition_huge_gun_trail
comment: The particles a Coalition Huge Gun's shot trails, of particle_pool: 120 to 129 ticks, 12 a tick, a half-size from 500 to 1100, orange fading to nothing

name: flak_pool
comment: The pool a flak shell's burst sends its particles into: 1000 over gunflare partic7, blended by alpha

name: flak_particles
comment: A flak shell's burst's particles, of flak_pool: 150 to 159 ticks, a half-size from 42 to 119, dimming from half grey, a spark one time in 200

name: case_texture
comment: gunflare case1, the spent cases' eight cells

name: case_pool
comment: The pool a spinning gun's spent cases fly from: 100 over case_texture, showing its own colours, blended by alpha

name: case_template
comment: A spent case, of case_pool: 100 to 109 ticks at a half-size of 15

name: case_emitter
comment: The emitter clip_event_particles throws each spent case from: back along its attachment at 10 a tick, strayed up to an eighth across

name: objects_reset
comment: As a mission starts: every slot of game_objects gets a stand-in of type 1001, flagged stand_in and not created, every ship type loses its objects and model, and game_object_count goes to 0; loads the atmos texture and empties the planets' atmosphere table

name: ship_type_load
comment: Loads a ship type's model, unless it is loaded already, and its schematic as the type's data, soft\ first for the software renderer

name: gun_groups_build
comment: Works out a ship type's gun groups from an object's guns, pairing each with the one nearest its mirror image across the ship, into the type's table at 0x545900 + type * 0x78 and the count at ship_combat_stats + 0x1C

name: object_random15
comment: The object's own random number from 0 to 32767: its seed steps as seed * 0x343FD + 0x269EC3, and bits 16 to 30 of it are the number

name: object_armor_conditions
comment: Works out the guns' condition (0x66C), the cruise speed's (0x668) and the shields' (0x664) from the armour left in each quadrant; for the player's ship, sounds a warning at most every 500 ticks while a quadrant has lost its shield and half its armour

name: guns_step
comment: An object's guns each simulation step: the charge recharges by gun_energy * gun_factor * gun_condition / (seconds * 25) up to gun_energy while +0x148 is zero. Each gun whose trigger is held fires once its interval has passed, drawing Gun.shot_energy from the charge or one of the object's rounds by the type's kind; the guns firing this step share out the charge the step began with. Below a gun_condition of 0.9 a shot goes off only as often as the condition plus a tenth, and blind fire lengthens the interval by 35 in 100

name: cutaway_slot
comment: The slot the loops over the objects walk after those handed out, which the mission's start sets to 399

name: mission_ship_create
comment: Creates the object of a mission's ship record in the slot of its index: its type, a player's twin from the 14th mission on, its tier and position, turned by the record's angles; nav points and markers too

name: object_orient_by_record
comment: Turns an object's root to a mission ship record's angles in degrees: yaw about Y, then pitch about X, then roll about Z

name: mat3_zero
comment: Zeroes a 3x3 matrix

name: ai_steer_angles
type: void __fastcall (GameObject *object, Vec3 *direction, float limit, float ease, uint flags)
comment: ai_steer's turns toward a point in the ship's own frame: within 18 degrees of the nose it yaws at it, further off it rolls to bring it overhead, and it pitches once the roll is within 0.8 radians. A ship flying backwards turns toward the other way about

name: ai_steer_axes
comment: ai_steer's turns for a ship whose flight stats hold a word at +0x24: it pitches and yaws at the point together and never rolls, and yaws hard to one side while the point is behind it

name: ai_roll_toward
comment: Rolls the ship so that axis stands up in its own frame, by ai_steer's measure, while at lies within 0.95 of dead ahead

name: objects_collide_parts
comment: Tests the ship of a pair against the parts of whichever object lists components, through 0x465380; type 0x83 runs 0x465B40 first

name: collision_damage
comment: The damage two objects do each other as they collide: a fifth of the closing speed over the lighter one's mass, halved, through each ship's shields and armour at the quadrant the other struck

name: collision_extent_compare
comment: qsort's comparator for the collision sweep: orders the entries by how far each sphere reaches along X, the farthest first

name: collision_impulse
comment: The shove two objects give each other where they meet: how fast the contact point closes between this step and the next, over each object's mass and angular_response, twice it for the bounce, handed to both through object_knock. An attached object, and the Ripper carrying something, take none

name: node_next_place
comment: A node's next place in the world: its own next place, turned and moved by each parent's in turn

name: node_world_place
comment: A node's place in the world: its own, turned and moved by each parent's in turn

name: mat3_add
comment: Adds a 3x3 matrix into another

name: vec3_cross_by
comment: Crosses a vector by another in place

name: det2
type: float __fastcall (float a, float b, float c, float d)
comment: The determinant of a 2x2 matrix: a*d - b*c, which mat3_determinant sums three of

name: collision_test_hull
comment: Tests a ship against the faces of each part of an object that lists components, by the planes the loader keeps past the part record, in place of the sphere test

name: model_take_chunk
comment: Reads the next chunk with this tag from the model file, allocating count records of size bytes and copying min(record size, size) into each; returns the count and leaves the rest zero

name: object_hit_test
comment: Tests a query against a node's collision tree, then against each child node that is neither hidden nor 0x80

name: node_hit_test
comment: Descends the collision tree of the node's part with a stack, calling test with each box in the world; a node with faces is a leaf

name: collision_hull_test
comment: The test node_hit_test calls as it descends a hull's tree for objects_collide: the query is a sphere, the box a tree node's in the world, and a leaf's faces are tested where it meets one

name: collision_hull_faces
comment: The nearest point of a leaf's faces to a point in the part's frame: each face whose plane the point is in front of, within the best distance so far, has its triangles tested; returns the distance squared

name: damage_quadrant
comment: Which quadrant a hit falls in, from where it lies in the object's frame as a share of its bounds: the larger of along and across decides, giving 2 fore, 3 aft, 1 right and 0 left

name: damage_by_difficulty
type: float10 __fastcall (int slot, DamageKind kind, float value)
comment: Scales damage by difficulty outside multiplayer: a kind equal to player_index, a shot in a single-player game, on a hostile object x1.5, x1 or x0.75 from easy to hard; anything on the player ship x0.75, x1 or x1.5, then x0.5

name: difficulty
comment: The game difficulty: 0 easy, 1 medium, 2 hard; SET GAME DIFFICULTY starts it at 1 and steps through them

name: damage_feedback
type: void __fastcall (int quadrant, DamageKind kind, float damage)
comment: While force_feedback is set, a hit on the player's ship: a shot starts force_shake and raises hit_shake by 0.05 of the damage while it is below 1, up to 1; any other hit adds 300 times the damage to force_hits on its side and raises hit_shake as much, up to 2

name: object_damage
type: void __fastcall (GameObject *object, int quadrant, float value, float factor, int attacker, DamageKind kind)
comment: Damage to an object: its shield in that quadrant takes it first, and what passes through times factor wears the armour; kinds 0, 1 and 5 count toward recent_damage. Debris and a jumping object take none

name: object_armor_damage
type: void __fastcall (GameObject *object, int quadrant, float value, int attacker, DamageKind kind)
comment: Damage to an object's armour once the shield is down: the quadrant's armour falls by it, the armour conditions follow, and armour below zero destroys the object

name: simplex_nearest_point
comment: The nearest point of a simplex to the origin, for 1 to 4 points, which the collision code uses for a triangle

name: object_fit_guns
comment: Fits an object with the guns its model holds: counts them, allocates gun_count records of 0x60 bytes and a word each, then fills them in

name: object_collect_guns
comment: Walks a node's children for the guns an object carries: an attachment of kind 3 is a gun of the type at the attachment's +0x64, and a turret part takes one by its turret kind. Called once to count and once to fill

name: part_is_turret
comment: Whether a node's part is a turret: its class is 3, 9, 10 or 18

name: turret_fit_aimed
comment: Fills the next gun record for an aimed turret (kind 1): the parts of the assembly sharing the turret part link id, not hidden, in slots 0 to 4 at +0x38 by their turret slot, slot 1 taking the base where none; the last muzzle; the firing arc of a component part at +0x58; no target; the owner object at +0x34; node flag 0x400 on the base

name: turret_fit_spin
comment: Fills the next gun record for a spinning gun (kind 2): the assembly parts in slots 0 to 4 at +0x1C, the last muzzle and its gun type, the owner object at +0x30, node flag 0x400 on slot 0

name: turret_fit_missile
comment: Fills the next gun record for a missile turret (kind 3): the assembly parts in slots 0 to 4 at +0x38, no target, the owner object at +0x34, node flag 0x400 on slot 0; no muzzle and no gun type

name: object_fire_guns
comment: Holds the trigger of the guns that fire, gun+0x0C becoming frame_start + ticks. With gun_mode.all every gun but a turret of kind 1, otherwise the chosen group's two; a muzzle of gun type 11 is passed over, and so is a ship whose guns are disabled. A ship of type 11 or 255 whose chosen group holds a gun type 11 charges it up in +0x148 instead, shaking the player's view

name: nova_release
comment: Lets a Phoenix's Nova Cannon go, in the first of the eight nova_beams free (none free, nothing): a remote player's at the charge given; below 0.5 the charge is lost. Otherwise the blast sounds, the nc effect plays, the player's beam strikes every object whose box it meets 40000 ahead (object_damage, or nova_strike_parts), and the beam shows 80 ticks, the charge spent

name: nova_helix
comment: The Nova Cannon's strands' helix at a point along it: radius 100, six turns a unit, 15000 long a unit from 600 ahead

name: nova_strike_parts
comment: The Nova Cannon's beam through a node and those hanging from it: each part whose box it meets takes the cannon's second damage times the charge against its component for each tree leaf it crosses, with a hit effect there

name: bullet_fire
type: void __fastcall (ModelNode *node, ShpPart *part, float speed_share, char heard)
comment: Fires one shot: takes a free record of the 200 at bullet_pool, sets its owner, fills it in (bullet_place), adds the owner's velocity times speed_share, plays the type's sound when heard, links it into the list ending at bullet_last, and sets the part's muzzle flash to end after gun_flash_ticks

name: bolt_build_messon
comment: The Messon Blaster's bolt for the index in EBX: as bolt_build_laser, 5 by 5, 400 longer for each index from 40, and taking colours of its own

name: bolt_build_turret_lasers
comment: The Turret Lasers' bolt, 200 by 200 by 2400, with two diamonds across its flight drawn from the shot texture's corner: at 0.6 of its length for variant 0, the player's side's set, or 0.15 for the rest's, and at 0.85. Near until 60000, its upright quad alone until 100000

name: bolt_build_tachyon
comment: One of the Tachyon Cannon's two pieces, each a single level to 1000000: for piece 0 a star of three blades 60 wide and 1600 long (0x004ADF90), for piece 1 a square 200 across (0x0044F000) textured from the shot texture's corner

name: bolt_build_neutron
comment: The Neutron Particle Gun's bolt: as bolt_build_laser, 80 by 80 by 1500, its upright quad alone out to 10000000, and taking colours of its own

name: bolt_build_gattling_plasma
comment: The Gattling Plasma Cannon's bolt for the index in EBX: as bolt_build_laser, 40 by 40, 150 longer for each index from 200

name: bolt_build_vulcan
comment: The Vulcan Battery's bolt: as bolt_build_laser, 40 by 40 by 300; guns_init builds four the same

name: bolt_build_nova
comment: The Nova Cannon's bolt: as bolt_build_laser, 180 by 180 by 10000, its upright quad alone out to 500000; each shot draws a copy of it (levels_copy)

name: bolt_build_allied_huge
comment: The Allied Huge Gun's shell: three squares through its centre, one in each plane, 1400 across, on alhuge, lit and added, one level at every distance

name: bolt_build_coalition_huge
comment: The Coalition Huge Gun's shell: as bolt_build_allied_huge, 3400 across, on clhuge

name: muzzle_flash_mesh_build
comment: A gun type's muzzle flash mesh, four quads on the texture given, added; guns_init builds one for each type into muzzle_flash_meshes

name: muzzle_flash_create
comment: A muzzle node's flash (gunbarrelflare_Mesh): a mesh object over the flash mesh of the gun type the node's attachment names, with its own texture coordinates

name: muzzle_flash_draw
comment: Readies a muzzle node's flash to be drawn: hides its frame once the tick at +0xBC has passed, else turns it as the attachment, shows the Gattling Plasma Cannon's sheet frame for frame_start, and scales it by the share of its gun type's gun_flash_ticks left, held between 0 and 1

name: nova_beams_frame
comment: Each frame from bullets_frame: each Nova Cannon beam past its time freed, the rest placed on their ships, the beam's blades scrolling and fading out over the last fifth, and after a full charge its 30 strands along the helix

name: nova_beam_free
comment: Frees a Nova Cannon beam's objects, the beam and but the first six of its strands, and marks it free

name: guns_load_shell
comment: Loads the Turret Flak's shell, the first part's levels of ship type 0xB1's model (shell.shp), into both sets of bolts

name: bullets_free_all
comment: Lets every shot go (bullet_free) and empties the list of those in flight

name: guns_shutdown
comment: Frees what guns_init built: the particle templates, the pool of shots, both sets of bolts but the shell, the muzzle flash meshes

name: mesh_build_star
type: void * __fastcall (int blades, void *texture, float radius, float half_length, float u0, float v0, float u1, float v1)
comment: A mesh of blades through the Z axis, spread evenly over half a turn, each a quad radius wide either side and half_length long either way, with the texture span given on every blade; lit, added, and taking colours of its own

name: mesh_build_square
type: void * __fastcall (char two_sided, uint flags, float width, float height)
comment: A rectangle facing along Z, width by height, as two triangles, or four where two_sided, over the whole of its texture

name: ship_type_first_levels
comment: Loads a ship type's model where none of its objects has yet, counts one more object of it, and returns its first part's levels

name: mesh_copy
comment: Copies a mesh into one allocation with arrays of its own; with polygon_flags, or mesh flag 0x10, the copy has a flag byte for each polygon

name: levels_copy
comment: A copy of a level set, 0x54 bytes, with a copy of each of its meshes

name: particle_template_create
comment: A particle template, 0x50 bytes, of a pool: kind (+0), life and its spread (+4, +8), then curves over a particle's life set with particle_curve_set, the rate an emitter streams at (+0xC), the half-size (+0x18) and the red, green and blue (+0x24, +0x30, +0x3C); the pool (+0x48) and how far a burst thins with distance (+0x4C), 1

name: particle_curve_set
type: void __thiscall (ParticleCurve *curve, float start, float middle, float end)
comment: Sets a curve over a particle's life to the quadratic through start, middle and end at its beginning, halfway and its end

name: particle_emitter_create
comment: A particle emitter, 0xFC bytes, of a template, born now: its life and birth (+0, +4), a frame of its own (+8), unturned, which a caller may hang off another; then the particles' direction and spread (+0xBC, +0xC8), speed and its range (+0xD4, +0xD8), what they inherit (+0xDC), the texture's span (+0xE8) and the template (+0xF8)

name: particles_init
comment: Makes particle_pools and in it particle_pool, of 1000 over gunflare\partic4, and sets the sparks up (sparks_init)

name: particles_reset
comment: Frees every particle of every pool, as a mission starts or ends

name: particles_shutdown
comment: Frees the pools

name: particle_pool_create
type: void * __fastcall (int count, void *texture, byte coordinates, byte lit, byte blend)
comment: A pool of count particles in particle_pools, 0x10 bytes: the count, the particles (0x18 bytes each: birth, life, velocity, template), a sprite set of as many over the texture, the sprites showing all of it, and how many are used

name: particle_pool_free
comment: Frees a pool's particles and sprite set

name: particle_emit
comment: Particle index born from an emitter, now: its life with a random spread, a velocity along the emitter's direction, strayed by its spread, at a random speed, turned into the world, plus what it inherits; its sprite where the emitter stands, showing the emitter's span

name: particle_spark
comment: A spark from an emitter, as fast as a particle leaves it but inheriting nothing, its velocity times 100 a second's: explosion_spark

name: particle_burst
comment: Count particles from an emitter at once, into the free ones: half as many behind the camera, and fewer with distance by the template's half-size halfway through, times 150, over the distance times the template's +0x4C

name: particle_stream
comment: What an emitter sends out over the frame, by its template's rate curve in hundredths, a roll a tick, thinned as a burst is; 0 once the emitter's life is over

name: particles_frame
comment: Once a frame, after the shots: first the sparks (sparks_update); then each particle alive moves on by its velocity and takes its half-size and colour from its template's curves; the rest are hidden; each pool's set is drawn up to its last particle alive

name: particle_pools
comment: Ten pools, 0x10 bytes each: particle_pool, the damaged ships' smoke's three (smoke_pool_light and the next two) and two others

name: particle_pool
comment: The explosions' pool, of 1000 over gunflare\partic4, added

name: particles_ready
comment: Set once particles_init has run

name: explode_flame_template
comment: The flame a blast bursts into: 500 ticks and up to 100 more, half-size 0 to 100 to 400, from yellowish white through orange to nothing

name: explode_sparkle_template
comment: The sparkle a blast leaves: 100 ticks and up to 500 more, half-size 0 to 25, white fading out

name: explosions_init
comment: Sets the explosions up: the debris and effect tables cleared, the particle templates the explosions use, and the frame explode_marker

name: bolt_levels
comment: Each gun type's bolts for the player's side, four slots a type less one, which guns_init builds and bullet_build draws the shots with

name: bolt_levels_other
comment: Each gun type's bolts for the other sides, as bolt_levels; the same meshes but for the Turret Lasers' rings

name: muzzle_flash_meshes
comment: Each gun type's muzzle flash mesh, by type less one

name: nova_beams
comment: The Nova Cannon's beams, 0x88 bytes each: the beam's object, 30 strands' objects, whether it fired full, until when it shows, and its ship

name: muzzle_flare_texture
comment: The texture matflarea3, drawn across the muzzle by every gun type's flash but the Gattling Plasma Cannon's

name: muzzle_tongue_texture
comment: The texture matflareb3, drawn down the flare by every gun type's flash but the Gattling Plasma Cannon's

name: muzzle_sheet_texture
comment: The texture gunflare\sfxalpha1, three frames the Gattling Plasma Cannon's flash plays through

name: guns_init
comment: Once at start-up: empties the 200 shots, loads gun_stats, requires the shot textures and builds each gun type's bolt meshes (0x00478460 and its fellows) into the tables at 0x005635E0 on and 0x00563010 on, the first set for the friendly side and the second for the rest

name: bolt_build_laser
comment: A level set of 0x54 bytes for a bolt sized by gun type 1's record (+0x04 half width, +0x08 half height, +0x0C length): two quads crossed along the flight until 15000, one quad until 100000, drawn with gunflare\lasers added and the object's own coordinates

name: bolt_build_proton
comment: The Proton Cannon's bolt, as bolt_build_laser with its size written in (50, 50, 1400) and lit by colours of the object's own

name: node_mount_muzzle
comment: Makes the node of kind 4 a gun muzzle attachment (kind 3) stands for, placed and turned exactly as the attachment is; object_collect_guns fits a gun on it and bullet_place fires along its Z axis

name: gun_atlas_starts
comment: The texel across the shot texture where each gun type's bolt begins, by gun type less one; -1 for a type drawn otherwise

name: gun_atlas_widths
comment: How many texels across each gun type's bolt spans, by gun type less one

name: bullet_lights_player
comment: The player's two latest shots, which cast a light; bullet_place puts a new one in the next slot, putting out the light of the shot it replaces

name: bullet_lights_player_next
comment: The slot of bullet_lights_player the player's next shot takes, 0 or 1

name: bullet_lights_other
comment: The two latest shots of every ship but the player's, which cast a light, as bullet_lights_player

name: bullet_lights_other_next
comment: The slot of bullet_lights_other the next such shot takes, 0 or 1

name: bullets_move
comment: Every shot in flight moves on by its velocity, which simulation_step runs after objects_update

name: bullets_frame
comment: The shots in flight once a frame, from the newest back: each is drawn between its last two places and coloured by the life it has left, tested against the objects it may reach (bullet_hit), and freed once it is spent or out of life (bullet_free)

name: bullet_hit
comment: What a shot strikes between its last place and its place now, among the objects bullet_place gave it. An object is struck where the segment first crosses the sphere of its radius: with a shield up in that quadrant the shot spends itself on the shield (object_damage with the type's first damage and its second over its first), with the shield down it reaches the hull (bullet_hull_hit). A candidate the shot has flown past is dropped from its list. An object whose components are listed is walked node by node, and the component struck takes the type's second damage

name: bullet_hull_hit
comment: A shot that has passed an object's shields: the last of the object's part nodes whose box the segment crosses decides that it hit, and the quadrant's armour takes the type's second damage; then, unless the camera is in the player's cockpit, 10 sparks of kind 2 (sparks_spray) from where it entered, in the part's frame, taken for the world

name: bullet_free
comment: Lets a shot go: unlinks it from the list of those in flight and frees what it was drawn with

name: object_turns_bullets
comment: Whether an object turns a shot: its spectral_shields flag. The gun type the shields are tuned to is handed over and ignored, so a ship with them on takes no damage from any shot

name: bullet_build
comment: Gives a new shot what it is drawn with, by a switch over its gun type less one: a mesh object over the type's bolt, sprite sets for a flare, or several of each hung off a frame at offsets drawn at random for some types; the Huge Guns add a light, a particle emitter and a glow. Meshes take their own texture coordinates: the type's span across gunflare\lasers and the top half for any side but hostile, the bottom for hostile.

name: bullet_hull_test
comment: The test node_hit_test calls as it descends an object's tree for bullet_hit: the query is a shot's segment, the box a tree node's in the world

name: bullet_candidate_test
comment: The test object_hit_test calls for bullet_place on an object that lists components: for a root node, whether the shot path meets its box, to walk on; for a shown part node that plays a track, or whose tree root box the path meets, adds the object and the node number at +0xFC to the shot candidates, up to 20, and walks no further into its tree

name: segment_meets_box
type: bool __fastcall (void *object, Vec3 *from, Vec3 *to, Vec3 *min, Vec3 *max, Vec3 *point)
comment: Whether a segment meets a box in an object's frame, the segment turned into it and over its scale, and where it enters, in that frame (bullet_hull_hit)

name: bullet_pool
comment: The 200 shots in flight, 0xC4 bytes each: bullet_fire takes the first whose type is -1

name: bullet_last
comment: The shot linked in last; each record holds the one before it at +0xBC and the one after at +0xC0

name: bullet_place
type: void __fastcall (int bullet, int gun_type, ModelNode *muzzle, ModelNode *node)
comment: Fills in a new shot: its type and the record at gun_stats, the owner's side, the muzzle's place and orientation, a velocity of Gun.speed along its nose, a life of Gun.lifetime ticks, a light, and the object it is expected to hit. A ship aiming blind aims at its target, and type 12 scatters

name: object_step_turrets
comment: Once a frame from orders_update for a ship that is not exploding and is not docking: runs each gun's turret routine from the table at 0x500FA0, indexed by the gun's turret kind

name: turret_spin_step
comment: A spinning gun (kind 2): its barrels loop their fire track; while its trigger is held they spin up by 0.1 a tick to 4, its gun track loops at their speed and its flaps open; otherwise they spin down by 0.02 a tick, its gun track stops and its flaps shut

name: turret_aim_angles
comment: The yaw and pitch that turn an aimed turret toward aim, from its base in the frames of the model root and the base part; false outside the base yaw limits where unequal, the pitching part pitch limits, or the firing arc at +0x58; a Huge Gun up to 20 degrees past a pitch limit aims at it

name: turret_in_line
comment: Whether point lies ahead of from along the forward axis of orientation and within radius of that line, as ai_along_nose with the place given apart

name: turret_aimed_track
comment: An aimed turret with a valid target leads it from its base, by 0.5 to 0.8 of the lead where its ECM is on, keeps the yaw and pitch still to turn toward it, and where the muzzle points from the base within twice the target radius of the aim holds its trigger a tick and plays the fire track of each part playing none; otherwise drops the target

name: turret_pick_target
comment: The first object in slot order an aimed turret can lead and aim at: type below 0x100, not its own, not its side nor neutral, a Huge Gun only a ship listing components; a ship listing components by its first reachable component, but by a Kurgan, Antanov, Nanny or Prowler turret

name: turret_aimed_step
comment: An aimed turret (kind 1): with a target, tracks it and turns base yaw and slot 1 and 2 pitch by what is left to turn, at most 0.02 a tick; every 100 to 199 ticks with none, picks one

name: turret_missile_step
comment: A missile turret (kind 3) by its state at +0x5C: searching the object nearest ahead of its launcher in lock range, tracking and launching a Screamer one time in five each 2000 ticks, six before reloading with its launcher reload track

name: powerup_give
type: void __fastcall (int slot, int unknown, PowerUp power_up)
comment: Hands an object a deathmatch power-up, the one named or else one by the weights at 0x005DB4C4, where the object is the player's or one is named: sets power_up, power_up_since and power_up_until and runs the record's start routine; a record flagged 2 is used at once through 0x004B1B20

name: sound_pitch_factor
comment: What n quarter tones up or down multiply a playback rate by, 2^(n/24), from tables clamped to 96 either way

name: sound_init
type: uint __fastcall (int voices, int speech, int redbook, char hardware)
comment: Starts Miles: the digital driver, a sample for each voice up to 16, the radio speech's double buffer where asked, the CD's audio where asked, and tick_timer; WinMain asks for 10 voices

name: sound_shutdown
comment: Ends the voices, stops the CD's audio, closes the music and shuts Miles down

name: sound_3d_providers
comment: Lists Miles's 3D providers, their handles at 0x00563A4C and their names at 0x00563A8C

name: sound_3d_close
comment: Closes the 3D provider, releasing its 3D voices, and frees smp3d.fat (sound3d_free)

name: sound_3d_open
comment: Opens a 3D provider by the game's number for it: 0 Miles Fast 2D Positional Audio, 1 Aureal A3D, 2 Creative Labs EAX, 3 RAD Game Tools RSX, with Dolby Surround where asked; a 3D voice for each sample it supports, up to 64; then sound3d_init

name: sound_3d_voice_end
comment: Ends what a 3D voice plays and frees it; the object or missile it followed has no voice left (+0xB96 to 0xFFFF)

name: sound_3d_end_all
comment: Ends every 3D voice's sound

name: sound_3d_update
comment: Once a frame: the player's engine (sound3d_engine_update), then each 3D voice freed once past its length (bytes / 441 ticks) or out of range, else placed again from the camera by what it follows

name: sound_play_on_voice
comment: Plays sound n of a bank on a given voice, ending what it played

name: sound_buffer_at
comment: Adds a positional sound of the first 18 slots to the frame's gathered levels in each ear, by its distance and which side of the camera it lies

name: sound_buffers_play
comment: Plays each positional sound gathered this frame, slot n as sound n of the bank (bank_stdsmp), panned by its two levels and as loud as the louder, then clears them

name: sound_voice_set_volume
comment: A playing voice's volume, 0 to 127, scaled by Fxvolume and Mastervolume

name: sound_voice_fade
comment: Fades a playing voice out by step every five ticks (tick_timer)

name: sound_fade_all
comment: Fades out every voice not finished

name: sound_end_all
comment: Ends every voice and forgets the gathered positional sounds

name: sound_pause_all
comment: Stops every playing voice where it is, remembering which at 0x00563A20

name: music_fade_out
comment: The music's level falls by step every five ticks until the stream closes

name: sound_volumes_apply
comment: Sets the volumes again: the music's, each voice's still playing, and the speech sample's

name: music_play
type: int __fastcall (char *path, int loops, int level, int now)
comment: Plays a file as a Miles stream at level and loops, now, or once the music playing has faded out; a piece the table at 0x005017A0 names loops back to its own offset

name: music_update
comment: Once a frame: the queued piece starts once the music has stopped

name: sound_driver_open
comment: Opens Miles's digital driver on the wave-out device, as PCM of the given channels, bits and rate

name: sound3d_init
comment: Loads smp3d.fat, scales the 3D sounds' distances by 0.0004, gives each 3D voice its class from the row for the provider's size, and finds the engine's and the afterburner's voices

name: sound3d_end_all
comment: Ends and frees every 3D voice playing

name: sound3d_play
type: int __fastcall (Vec3 *at, Vec3 *facing, int owner, int sound, float volume, int unused, char class)
comment: Plays a 3D sound of the table at 0x00507140, placed by what it follows, on a voice of its class, else one not reserved, else a borrowed one; not started beyond its maximum distance but for the engines' sounds

name: sound3d_engine_sound
comment: The player's engine sound by its ship type: PSHIP01 on

name: sound3d_engine_update
comment: The player's engine pitched and loudened by its throttle, the afterburner's or reverse thrust's sound while either is on and its fade after, then the fighters heard flying past the camera

name: sound3d_pause
comment: Stops every 3D voice playing

name: shield_bubble_object
comment: A shield bubble's scene object, named Shield mesh, over the finest level (flags 0x280800), its texture coordinates each vertex's x and y, scaled by the float on the stack

name: sphere_mesh_create
type: void * __fastcall (int around, int down, float radius)
comment: A sphere of radius on a grid of around slices and down bands: a fan round each pole and two triangles a slice between, over shield128, lit and added

name: shield_bubble_update
comment: Moves a bubble on by ticks: each vertex's colour the sum of its eight hits' faded strengths through its tint's ramp, or a force field's grey flicker; then the texture swirls about the bubble's centre, which turns

name: shield_ramp_friendly_colour
comment: A friendly ship's ramp colour at a strength: cyan at 0.6, dark at 1 and below 0.35, grey without a hardware renderer, times 0.07

name: shield_ramp_other_colour
comment: The other sides' ramp colour at a strength: the friendly one's green and blue swapped, times 0.8 and 0.07

name: shield_ramp_friendly_at
comment: The friendly ramp's colour at a strength strictly between 0 and 1, else black

name: shield_ramp_other_at
comment: The other sides' ramp colour at a strength strictly between 0 and 1, else black

name: shield_ramps_build
comment: Fills both ramps, 1024 steps each

name: shield_levels_build
comment: The six levels' spheres from shield_level_grids, and their reaches by the detail

name: shield_levels_free
comment: Frees the six levels' spheres

name: shields_init
comment: The shields' textures, ramps and levels, and the capital shields' pool emptied

name: shields_deinit
comment: Frees the capital shields still showing and the levels

name: shield_bubble_create
comment: A shield bubble, 0x48 bytes: kind 1, its scene object, the tick made, never struck, its texture centre at (0.3, 0.3), eight hits' strengths, and the side it glows for

name: shield_bubble_free
comment: Frees a bubble's scene object and hits

name: shield_bubbles_draw
comment: Once a frame: each bubble struck in the last 100 ticks at the level of detail its distance gives, save the player's from its cockpit; stops at one past the last level; then the capital shields

name: shield_flare
comment: A ship's shields struck at a point while any holds anything: sparks of kind 3, and the bubble's next hit by each vertex's angle from the point

name: shield_bubble_drawn
comment: The bubble object's callback as it is drawn: unless paused, shield_bubble_update by the ticks since its last

name: capshield_flare
comment: A capital ship's shield struck on a node's polygon: nothing on an object whose invulnerable is 5, or on a force field of one exploding; the node's slot shows 200 more ticks and becomes capshield_next, else a copy is made in capshield_next; a force field's vertices all take 1, any other's round the polygon's middle twice their share of the reach; polygons dark in the hit are marked 1

name: capshield_create
comment: A pool slot's Capshield mesh copy of a node's finest mesh, every polygon drawn, one lit additive pass over shield128 or ffield, living 200 ticks; the side goes unread

name: capshield_free
comment: Frees a pool slot's copy and hits

name: capshields_draw
comment: Each capital shield still showing faded and drawn, three times as bright as a bubble, swirling about (0.5, 0.5); a force field's coordinates thrown at random

name: part_is_force_field
comment: Whether a part's name holds FORCEFIELD

name: force_field_mark
comment: Sets flag 0x20 on each node of a tree whose part is a force field

name: cosine_ease
comment: From a to b as a share goes from 0 to 1, slow at each end: (b - a) * (cos(share * pi + pi) * 0.5 + 0.5) + a

name: shield_texture
comment: shield128, which the bubbles and capital shields are drawn over

name: force_field_texture
comment: ffield, which a force field and a flickering bubble are drawn over

name: shield_ramp_friendly
comment: A friendly ship's bubble colours, 1024 steps of three floats

name: shield_ramp_other
comment: The other sides' bubble colours, 1024 steps of three floats

name: shield_levels
comment: The six levels' sphere meshes, finest first

name: shield_level_reaches
comment: How far from the camera each level is drawn out to, from shield_level_reaches_by_detail

name: shield_level_count
comment: The levels of detail, 6

name: shield_level_grids
comment: Each level's slices around and bands down: 16 by 14, 12 by 10, 10 by 8, 8 by 6, 6 by 4, 4 by 4

name: shield_level_reaches_by_detail
comment: The six reaches for each detail: from 1250 to 40000, 2500 to 80000, 10000 to 320000

name: capshields
comment: The capital shields showing, 50 of 0x3C bytes: the node, its copy, when it ends, when it last moved, eight hits, the next, a force field

name: capshield_next
comment: The capital shields' pool slot the next takes

name: shieldfx_create
comment: What a hit leaves where it struck, 12 bytes, by kind: 2 a hull hit, an orange emitter facing out from the surface and ARMOUR01 at the point in the part's frame, or PLAYERHIT on the player's ship at most every 30 ticks; 3 a component hit, a burst of 20; 4 a grey emitter; 5 sound 71 and 0x00472780

name: mesh_nearest_surface
comment: The point of a node's mesh nearest a point in the world, by each front-facing polygon's nearest point (simplex_nearest_point), and the surface's normal there

name: shieldfx_init
comment: Once: gunflare_sfxalpha1, and the orange and grey templates of what a hit leaves

name: shieldfx_free
comment: Frees what a hit left, and the emitter of kinds 2 to 4

name: shieldfx_deinit
comment: Frees the two templates

name: node_add_effect
comment: Hangs what a hit left from the node struck, as a node of kind 6 in a free child slot; for kind 3 it first clears nearby ones and the oldest past ten, and flares a shield generator's capital shield instead

name: shieldfx_orange
comment: The orange template of what a hit leaves: 100-tick particles growing from 50 to 100, fading from orange

name: shieldfx_grey
comment: The grey template of what a hit leaves: 50-tick particles growing from 25 to 50

name: player_hit_at
comment: When a shot last sounded PLAYERHIT on the player's hull

name: shieldfx_ready
comment: Set once shieldfx_init has run

name: shieldfx_texture
comment: gunflare_sfxalpha1

name: vec3_cosine
comment: The cosine of the angle between two vectors

name: sound3d_definitions
comment: The 3D sounds, closed by a record whose entry is -1

name: sound3d_class_rows
comment: Each 3D voice's class, 32 to a row: for up to 14 voices, up to 30, and more

name: sound3d_class_names
comment: Names of the voice classes, 30 characters each

name: engine_sound_rates
comment: The player's engine sound's playback rate at no throttle, by ship type

name: engine_sound_rates_by_throttle
comment: What full throttle adds to it

name: engine_sound_volumes
comment: Its volume at no throttle

name: engine_sound_volumes_by_throttle
comment: What full throttle adds to it

name: music_loops
comment: The music's loop points: each piece's name and the byte its loop starts at

name: sound3d_classes
comment: Each 3D voice's class

name: sound3d_engine_changed_at
comment: When the afterburner last came on or went off

name: sound_engine_voice
comment: The 3D voice of class player engines

name: sound_burner_voice
comment: The 3D voice of class player burners

name: sound_driver
comment: Miles's digital driver

name: music_level
comment: The music's level, 0 to 127, which fades

name: sound_buffered
comment: Each positional sound's level in the left ear and the right, gathered over a frame

name: volume_master
comment: Mastervolume, 0 to 127

name: volume_effects
comment: Fxvolume

name: volume_music
comment: Musicvolume

name: volume_speech
comment: Speechvolume

name: sound_settings_save
comment: Writes Fxvolume, Musicvolume, Speechvolume and Mastervolume to [Sound] of the settings file

name: armor_warned_at
comment: The frame_start the player's armour last warned at: object_armor_conditions warns no more than once in 500 ticks

name: shockwave_init
comment: Requires the ring textures rng_02, rng_03, rng_04, rng_01 and rng_06 into shockwave_textures, builds a ring over each into shockwave_meshes, and a sphere of 16 by 14 into shockwave_sphere, which nothing draws

name: shockwave_ring_mesh
comment: A ring over shockwave_textures[ring]: 8 points a unit out and 8 a tenth out about Z, 16 triangles between them, textured by how far each corner lies across and up either way, at least 1/64, coloured and added

name: sphere_mesh
type: void * __fastcall (int segments, int rings, float radius)
comment: A sphere of the radius, segments round and rings from pole to pole, textured by 0x00593798 with generated coordinates, coloured and added

name: shockwave_free
comment: Frees a shockwave's ring object and its slot

name: shockwave_deinit
comment: Frees every shockwave, the meshes and the sphere, and releases the textures

name: shockwaves_update
comment: Once a frame after explosions_update: each shockwave drifts by its velocity times frame_duration, its ring's colours fade from 1 to 0 over its life and it spreads to its size times how far through its life it is; as it passes the player kinds 0 to 2 raise hit_shake, 7 and 8 damage the player's quadrants through the shield reserves; 5 pushes and 6 damages other sides' ships; kind 7 is not drawn

name: shockwave_create
type: void __fastcall (Vec3 *at, float *orientation, Vec3 *velocity, int kind, float size, int life, char side, int owner)
comment: Sets a shockwave off into the first free of shockwaves (asserting shockwave count exceeded where none is): its kind's ring, never culled and coloured by its own colours, at scale 0

name: shockwaves
comment: Thirty shockwaves, 0x2C bytes each: kind, ring object, velocity a tick, size, birth, life, owner, side

name: shockwave_meshes
comment: The rings shockwave_ring_mesh builds, one over each of shockwave_textures

name: shockwave_textures
comment: rng_02, rng_03, rng_04, rng_01 and rng_06

name: shockwave_sphere
comment: The sphere shockwave_init builds, which nothing draws

name: debris_free
comment: Frees a debris record's object and its smoke emitter

name: SR_object_concate_parents
comment: An object's place in the world (+0x70, +0x4C) from its own (+0x3C, +0x18) and its parent's, the parents' first

name: scene_object_free
comment: Unlinks an object and frees it, and its mesh or its levels' meshes where flag 0x4000 says they are its own

name: sparks_init
comment: Builds the shape of each of the five spark kinds (spark_shape_build) and clears sparks

name: sparks_deinit
comment: Frees the spark shapes' meshes

name: sparks_reset
comment: Frees every spark

name: sparks_update
comment: Each spark past its kind's life is freed; the rest move on by velocity and carried velocity times the ticks since the last update, slow by the drag to the power of them, turn, grow or fade late by the kind's flags, and take the colour between the kind's first and last by how far through their life they are

name: spark_add
type: void __fastcall (int kind, Vec3 *at, Vec3 *carried, Vec3 *direction, float speed)
comment: A spark of the kind in the next of sparks, freeing what was there: its shape's levels, never culled and coloured by its own colours, looking along direction, at direction times speed a tick, drifting with carried

name: sparks_spray
type: void __fastcall (int kind, Vec3 *at, Vec3 *carried, Vec3 *direction, float speed, float spread, float speed_range, short count)
comment: count sparks along direction turned by a random pitch and yaw within half the spread either way, at speed and up to half the range either way; kinds 2 and 3 only within 20000 of the camera

name: spark_free
comment: Frees a spark's object and record

name: spark_shape_build
comment: Kind 0: a beam of three crossed quads over alhuge, drawn out to 1500000; the rest: two quads crossed along the length over lasers, out to the look's first distance, then one quad with generated coordinates out to its second

name: spark_looks
comment: Five spark kinds, 0x68 bytes each: half width, half height and length, two distances, texture name, texture span, first and last colour, life, drag, three flags

name: spark_next
comment: The slot of sparks the next spark takes

name: sparks_moved_at
comment: The frame_start the sparks last moved on at

name: sparks
comment: The sparks flying, 0x24 bytes each: kind, object, birth, velocity a tick, carried velocity a tick

name: spark_shapes
comment: Each spark kind's levels, 0x54 bytes each: count, distances, meshes

name: ai_target_node
comment: The node the AI aims at on a target: its component's node, the root's child 0x14 for types 0x43 and 0x49, 0x11 for 0x47, 0x13 for 0x48, else the root

name: ai_lead_aim
type: bool __fastcall (Vec3 *out, int slot, OrderEntry *entry, float lead)
comment: Picks the fastest of the guns the ship fires together (its group's two, or all) and leads the target with it (ai_lead_aim_with_gun)

name: ai_lead_aim_with_gun
type: bool __fastcall (Vec3 *out, void *node, OrderEntry *entry, int gun, float lead)
comment: Aims at the target's node, ahead along its heading by its speed times lead times the gun's flight time to it; false, leaving the node's place, when the flight takes a quarter of the gun's lifetime or more (three times the lifetime for the Turret Flak)

name: ai_along_nose
comment: Whether the point lies ahead of the frame and within radius of the line along its nose

name: ai_collision_course
type: bool __fastcall (int slot, int target, float steps, float margin, int *node, int *part)
comment: Whether the ship is on course to hit the target within steps: within reach at both cruise speeds, the target ahead, closing by the ship's velocity less twice the target's to within both radii and the margin; against a target with components, the part it would hit

name: ai_escape_direction
comment: The way clear of a ship hull from a point: each box of the collision trees of the parts on its root within 20000 of the point pushes away from it, harder the nearer; the sum normalized

name: player_control_entry
comment: The entry of the player's orders that is Player Control, which holds the player's target, or null for none

name: player_target_set
type: void __fastcall (short index, short component, int unused)
comment: Aims the player's Player Control order at an object and a component, then has the display follow it (hud_target_changed) and tells a multiplayer game (player_target_send)

name: player_target_cycle
type: bool __fastcall (short next, short among, int unused)
comment: Steps the player's target round the objects, the next where next is 1 and the previous otherwise, to one it can aim at, ejected ones included and cloaked friendly ones, not the player's: hostile within twice pick_range for among 1, friendly within it for 2, any for 0. None found leaves no target. The display follows either way. Returns whether one was found

name: player_subtarget_cycle
comment: Gives both forms of the target display their full time again, then for a target that lists components and is not friendly opens its form if shut and steps its component round to the next targetable one not hidden, or to none

name: player_target_send
comment: Sends the player's target to the other players in a multiplayer game, message 3

name: nav_point_next
comment: Takes as hud_object's nav point the first of the mission's nav points that the player's ship is still farther from than its reach, or none

name: hud_target_changed
comment: Follows a change of the player's target: copies it into hud_shown_target, points hud_target_object at it while it can be aimed at, and opens its form of the target display held, closing the other; with no target closes both

name: hud_target
comment: Draws the player's target in view 0. Off the screen or behind: an arrow from the middle, lines of palette 0x26 for a hostile target and 0x62 for the rest (0xB1 and 200 in software), none in the chase view, which shows chase_target_pointer instead; and a marker where a line its way leaves the screen, shapes 0x16C to 0x16F hostile or 0x170 to 0x173, with the range in font_small. On it: brackets 0x122, or 0x126 hostile, at the corners of its box as the camera sees it, dimmed by missile_lock_count; the range in font_new; and for a target that lists no components and is not friendly the lead cursor 0x12F at ai_lead_aim's point with a line toward the target, which sets hud_target_x and hud_target_y. Also marks the radio window's object (hud_comms_marker) and the nav point

name: hud_pointer_direction
comment: The unit way across and down to a target's node in hud_object's frame, turned a half round, and that way turned a quarter round more

name: hud_comms_marker
comment: Draws shapes 0x12A to 0x12D at the corners of the object 0x0057BDF4 names, which the radio's window sets

name: hud_missile_lock
comment: Runs the player's missile lock: its state at 0x0057DFF0 (0 idle, 1 closing, 2 waiting out the lock time, 3 locked, 5 lost), missile_lock_count and the ticks from minus the lock time, and places the three lock_rings on the line from the camera to the target node; in the chase view adds chase_target_pointer and chase_nav_pointer to the scene. Its building sound (0x0057DFC0) never plays, and it ends 2D voice 0 every frame

name: line_clip
comment: Clips a line to a pane in whole numbers, cutting an end outside back to the edge it crosses, then keeps both ends on the screen if any of the line is on the pane, which it counts at 0x005D60DC

name: fonts_open
comment: Once: builds the remap tables text is drawn through, text_colours and the side tables among them, and opens the fonts, font_small and font_new among them

name: hud_shown_target
comment: The player's target as the display has it, an order's entry of which only the target's index (0x005799EC) and component (0x005799EE) are set: hud_draw copies the Player Control order's target each frame, as hud_target_changed does

name: hud_target_object
comment: The object the display draws as the target, while the player can aim at it, a cloaked friendly one too outside a multiplayer game; null otherwise

name: hud_under_reticle
comment: The first object other than the player's within 0x20 of the middle of the screen either way, in front of the camera, which hud_target_keys finds and TARGET UNDER RETICULE takes; -1 for none

name: missile_lock_count
comment: The missile lock's count: 100 while no lock builds, down by the frame's ticks to 0 as one does, and back up as it is lost. hud_target draws the brackets at its hundredths of their brightness, none at a tenth or less, and shortens the lead cursor's line by 0.28 for each short of 100

name: pick_range
comment: 330000: the targeting keys reach twice as far from the player's ship

name: hud_lead_point
comment: Where hud_target's lead cursor aims, which the player's guns aim at while blind fire does

name: nav_point_count
comment: How many flyback markers the mission's script has set (SetFlybackMarker), ten at most; hud_init clears it

name: nav_points
comment: The flyback markers' objects, nav_point_count of them, -1 for one gone

name: nav_point_reaches
comment: How far the player's ship may stray from each flyback marker before nav_point_next points it back there: SetFlybackMarker's reach

name: chase_sight_near
comment: The chase view's near sight, a 600 square of chasetarget at full strength, which camera_chase stands 6000 ahead of the player's ship

name: chase_sight_far
comment: The chase view's far sight, a 600 square of chasetarget half grey, which camera_chase stands 12000 ahead of the player's ship

name: chase_blind_mark
comment: The chase view's mark of where blind fire aims, a 600 square, white, which hud_missile_lock stands 6000 from the ship toward hud_lead_point while blind fire aims

name: chase_pointer_roll
comment: The angle hud_target turns chase_target_pointer by about the ship's nose, less half a turn: the way to the target from straight up, going round to the right

name: hud_on
comment: While clear, hud_draw draws nothing and hud_missile_lock shows no chase view objects; hud_init sets it and nothing clears it

name: chase_target_pointer
comment: The chase view's pointer to the target, a scene object turned with the player's ship; bit 0 of its +0x14 hides it

name: chase_nav_pointer
comment: The chase view's pointer to the nav point, as chase_target_pointer

name: font_small
comment: smlfont.fnt, opened: the range by hud_target's marker at the screen's edge

name: font_new
comment: newfont.fnt, opened: the range by hud_target's brackets

name: text_colours
comment: The remap table most of the display's text is drawn through: each index itself, but 0, which is 0xFF

name: friendly_text_colours
comment: As text_colours, with 0xF7 as 0xD7: hud_target's range for a friendly target

name: hostile_text_colours
comment: As text_colours, with 0xF7 as 0x4C: hud_target's range for a hostile target

name: neutral_text_colours
comment: As text_colours: hud_target's range for a neutral target

name: ship_status_hits
comment: A flag for each quadrant of the player's ship whose armour a hit wore (object_armor_damage), which hud_ship_status flashes on the schematic as shapes 1 to 4 and clears

name: target_status_hits
comment: A flag for each quadrant of the target of the player's current order whose armour a hit wore (object_armor_damage), for the target display

name: primary_target
comment: The mission's primary target, the object's index then its component, -1 in both for none: SetPrimaryTarget sets it, PRIMARY TARGET makes it the player's, and mission_start clears it

name: sprite_block
comment: The address of block index of a loaded sprite set: its directory entry's offset from the set's start. hud_target hands palette_to_vfx the display's palette block this way

name: comms_menu_run
comment: Runs the radio's menu while its window is open, which hud_target_keys calls first: by the page at 0x00529530, sets the page's title string at 0x00529FB4 and runs its keys

name: player_friend_destroyed
comment: Sets +0x678 of the player's ship to 1, or to 2 and sends it in a multiplayer game when told is 1: object_armor_damage and component_damage call it as the player's shot destroys a friend or a friend's component

name: friendly_fire_warning
comment: Outside a multiplayer game, adds the player's damage to a friend to 0x00562CEC; past 0x004DC5EC, at most once every 3000 ticks, a friend complains on the radio with one of four lines from ff_001.ut on, drawn with rand. Its count at 0x00562CF0 is held at 1, so the second set of lines (ff_005.ut on) never plays

name: missile_lock_possible
comment: Whether the armed missile of the ring can lock on the target: one is armed, not of type 6, the target can be aimed at, the player's missiles are not disabled, outside a multiplayer game the target is hostile and the type not 0, and the target's node is within the type's range (+0x1C of its stats) and ahead of the ship

name: missile_lock_same
comment: Whether the lock building is still on the target, the component and the missile type it began on (0x0057E024, 0x0057E026, 0x0057DFB8)

name: hud_display_target
comment: The target the target display last drew, which hud_window_close draws the closing form's picture for and hud_subtarget picks out

name: hud_display_component
comment: The subtarget the target display last drew, -1 from window 3, which hud_window_close draws the closing form's picture for

name: hud_bar_pane
comment: A VFX pane the display cuts its bars into: the large target display's hull and subtarget armour bars, and the damage display's

name: hud_font
comment: blufont.fnt, opened (soft_blufont.fnt for the software renderer): the font of every line of the display's own text

name: mission_end_record
comment: As a mission ends, unless the player was destroyed or quit (mission_ending 1 or 3): promotes the pilot by skull_count against rank_kills, keeps the rank for the mission, moves mission_number on, and keeps the pilot's rank, medals and skull_count (0x00562D1C to 0x00562D24) for the next mission's start

name: rank_kills
comment: The kills each rank needs: 0, 35, 72, 115, 150, 200, 255, 275 and 300

name: skull_count_kept
comment: skull_count as the last mission the player came through left it, which WinMain puts back before each single-player mission

name: mission_kills
comment: The pilot's kills in each mission of the campaign, by mission_number, which kills_add counts for the local player

name: kill_credit_on
comment: While set, explode_kill_credit credits kills and has their radio lines said. A mission's start sets it (0x004560F0), and the radio's states 0x14 and 0x15 set and clear it

name: mission_start
comment: A mission's start, the first of main.cpp's code: among much else it sets the rescue odds to always picked up and fits the player's ship with its devices and its cockpit

name: rescue_odds_rescued
comment: The weight of an ejected pilot being picked up by a nanny ship, which order_eject draws from: 100 from a mission's start, and SetRescueProbabilities' first argument

name: rescue_odds_captured
comment: The weight of an ejected pilot being picked up by the enemy: 0 from a mission's start, and SetRescueProbabilities' second argument

name: rescue_odds_killed
comment: The weight of an ejected pilot being killed: 0 from a mission's start, and SetRescueProbabilities' third argument

name: radar_contacts
comment: The radar's contacts, radar_contact_count of them, 20 bytes each: the dot's x and y and the height as ints, then whether hostile, the line's palette entry and whether the nav point as shorts

name: radar_contact_count
comment: The contacts in radar_contacts this frame

name: radar_reach
comment: How far each radar range reaches: 90000, 150000 and 230000

name: radar_scale
comment: The share of a unit of the world a radar pixel stands for at each range: a 150000th, a 230000th and a 330000th

name: comms_object
comment: The object the radio's window names, whose corners hud_comms_marker marks and whose radar contact shows in palette entry 0xFD with shape 0xE6

name: SR_CCB_quantize_color
type: byte __thiscall (void *ccb, float red, float green, float blue)
comment: The palette entry of a colour table (CCB) nearest a colour of three levels from 0 to 1

name: explosion_spark
comment: Throws a small piece of debris into the next of explosion_bits, picked as explosion_bit picks one: at, flying at velocity a second, half to one and a half times size across, tumbling up to 0.05 a frame about each axis, for -100 to 300 ticks. particle_spark's, at size 0.1

name: mission_end
comment: A mission's end: among much else it frees the smoke's templates and pools (smoke_templates), the debris models, the radar's backing, the samples, the speech and the cockpit object, and ends the sounds and the music

name: smoke_start
type: void __fastcall (GameObject *object, ShpPart *part, int child, int attachment, int level)
comment: Starts an object's smoke again for level (smoke), from the engine glow attachment on part, the root's child: frees the old emitter, and for levels 1 to 3 hangs one from the child's frame where the attachment stands, turned as it is, its Z axis turned back where the attachment's length (+0x50) is negative, streaming along Z at 30 to 36 a tick, strayed 0.15 either way across at level 1 and 0.25 above, for 999999 ticks

name: smoke_template_create
comment: The smoke's template for level 1 to 3 and its pool of 1000: over gunflare\partic4, added, at 1 and 2, and gunflare\partic7, premultiplied, at 3, with sparks one time in 200; living 70 to 79 ticks at 1 and 100 to 109 above; mission_start makes the three into smoke_templates

name: smoke_templates
comment: The smoke's templates for levels 1 to 3 (smoke_template_create); smoke_start reads the level's from four bytes before, so level 0 reads paused_ticks, and makes no emitter for it

name: smoke_pool_light
comment: The pool of the smoke's level 1 (smoke_template_create); smoke_pool_heavy and smoke_pool_burning follow

name: smoke_pool_heavy
comment: The pool of the smoke's level 2

name: smoke_pool_burning
comment: The pool of the smoke's level 3

name: install_paths_read
comment: Reads the install's paths from HKLM Software\Microsoft\Microsoft Games\Starlancer\1.0: PID, InstallType, CDPath with game appended (cd_path) and InstallationDirectory with a backslash (install_directory). InstallType 3, a full install, sets full_install and both discs' folders to the installation directory. Without the key or either path, the current directory stands for all of them, as a full install

name: cd_in_drive
comment: Which disc is in the drive: 1 or 2 by which of cd1.bin and cd2.bin is in cd_path, or -1 for neither. In a full install cd_path is first set to the current disc's folder. Looks from cd_path and moves back into install_directory

name: cd_hog_open
comment: Opens the disc's cd%d.hog (cd_hog) from cd_path. In a full install cd_path is first set to that disc's folder; otherwise, with the other disc in the drive (cd_in_drive), it closes the hog and waits with an overlay (0x00430110) for the disc to be changed. Can't open HOG resource file is fatal

name: full_install
comment: Whether the hogs of both discs are read from folders of their own rather than the drive: an InstallType of 3, or no install in the registry (install_paths_read)

name: cd_current
comment: The disc whose hog is open, 1 or 2 (cd_hog_open)

name: cd_path
comment: Where the disc's hog is read from: the drive's game folder, or in a full install the current disc's folder

name: install_directory
comment: The installation directory, with a backslash, which the game works in

name: cd1_folder
comment: In a full install, where cd1.hog is: the installation directory

name: cd2_folder
comment: In a full install, where cd2.hog is: the installation directory

name: cd_hog
comment: The open disc's cd%d.hog (cd_hog_open)

name: menu_box_draw
type: void __fastcall (int x0, int y0, int x1, int y1)
comment: Outlines a rectangle on hud_pane in direct-colour reds: top and left 205, right and bottom 102.5, and a rectangle one pixel inside at 164. The pause menu frames its dialog and key lists with it

name: menu_mouse_update
comment: Moves menu_cursor_x and menu_cursor_y by the mouse, within the screen, puts the system cursor back near the window corner after a move, and sets menu_mouse_down, menu_mouse_pressed and menu_mouse_released from the left or right button

name: menu_draw
type: int __fastcall (int count, void *shapes, MenuItem *items, MenuString title, int mouse)
comment: Draws a pause menu title in optfnt over a red rule and count items of 0x30 bytes, each shape placed by screen fractions and offsets with its hover shape under the cursor, then each string white when highlighted, else orange; returns the item under the cursor or -1, testing none when mouse is 0

name: pause_screen_quit
comment: Pause screen 0, which nothing selects: four QUIT buttons going to screens 1, 6, 5 and 7; Escape goes to 6

name: pause_screen_debug
comment: Pause screen 8, which nothing reaches: lists the mission ships, sync states and globals on screen and appends them to c:\mission.txt every frame

name: pause_session_lost
comment: Pause screen 9 once mission_ending is 9: a dialog saying the session was terminated for a bad connection, whose OK leaves the mission as the button is released

name: pause_multiplayer_enter
comment: Entering pause screen 9: clears the scoreboard rows and lag flags, no player to drop, and makes menu_dialog_pane

name: pause_multiplayer_exit
comment: Leaving pause screen 9: destroys menu_dialog_pane

name: pause_screen_multiplayer
comment: Pause screen 9: PAUSED, LEAVE MISSION (7) and CONTINUE (6), the deathmatch scores with a drop button for each player lagging past 100, the message log, the chat line and who paused or why; Escape goes to 6

name: pause_screen_main
comment: Pause screen 1: SELECT AN OPTION, icons AUDIO (3), CONTROL DEVICES (2) and VIDEO (4), buttons LEAVE MISSION (7), RESTART (5) and CONTINUE (6); Escape goes to 6

name: pause_audio_enter
comment: Entering pause screen 3: keeps the four volumes for Cancel Changes and ends any drag

name: pause_screen_audio
comment: Pause screen 3, SOUND CONFIGURATION: speech, effects, music and master sliders 0 to 127 dragged by their knobs, a test sound as the effects knob is let go, OK (1), RESTART (5), CONTINUE (6), RESET DEFAULTS and CANCEL CHANGES; Escape goes to 1

name: pause_video_enter
comment: Entering pause screen 4: keeps cockpit_mode_setting and the brightness at sr + 0x15FA for Cancel Changes

name: pause_screen_video
comment: Pause screen 4, GRAPHICS CONFIGURATION: a BRIGHTNESS slider 0.5 to 2 while sr + 0x38 has bit 0, DEFAULT VIEW cycling cockpit, chase and no cockpit, OK (1), RESTART (5), CONTINUE (6), RESET DEFAULTS and CANCEL CHANGES; Escape goes to 1

name: video_settings_save
comment: Leaving pause screen 4: writes [Device] gamma, the brightness in hundredths, and [Device] View to the settings file

name: pause_controls_enter
comment: Entering pause screen 2: makes its three panes, reloads the bindings (key_config_defaults, load_key_config), numbers controls_list and keeps the settings and control_bindings for Cancel Changes

name: pause_controls_draw
comment: Draws pause screen 2: its items with the current check boxes and dimming, and the scrolled action and binding lists; returns the item under the cursor, 100 plus the action for a list row, or -1

name: pause_controls_conflict
comment: Pause screen 2's dialog for a key or button already bound: YES takes it from the other action, NO keeps waiting, as the button is released

name: pause_screen_controls
comment: Pause screen 2, CONTROL CONFIGURATION: controller and joystick settings, rebinding an action by clicking its row then pressing a key or joystick button, scrolling, OK (1), RESTART (5), CONTINUE (6), RESET DEFAULTS and CANCEL CHANGES; Escape goes to 1

name: pause_controls_exit
comment: Leaving pause screen 2: destroys its panes and calls save_key_config

name: pause_menu_open
comment: As the game pauses: opens optfnt.fnt and smlfnt2.fnt from resource.hog into menu_fonts, fills menu_text_remap, starts on screen 9 in a multiplayer session or 1 otherwise, and ends the missile lock tone

name: pause_menu_close
comment: As the game resumes: frees the two fonts pause_menu_open opened

name: pause_menu_draw
